#### The four archetypes worth specifying in full here

The remaining 24 follow the same shape; these four carry 103 screens between
them and set the conventions the others inherit.

**`ARC-15` · Form / single-page capture — 41 screens**

*Layout.* `Z4` title + primary actions · `Z5` field groups, one column at ≤1024px
and two above · `Z7` sticky save bar with an autosave timestamp · `Z8` for
confirm and reason dialogs.

*Canonical workflow.* 1 Load with defaults and carried-forward values, each
marked as such → 2 AI drafts the draftable sections (`AIP-01`, `G2`) → 3 User
edits; validation on blur, never on keystroke → 4 User dispositions every `G2`
item → 5 Primary action enables only when all ✅ fields are valid **and** every
`G2` item has a disposition → 6 Submit or sign → 7 Navigate to the caller.

*States.* All 14. `ERROR` must preserve typed content and offer a copy-out
escape hatch — losing a clinician's typed note is the fastest way to lose the
clinician. `LOCKED` renders read-only with an `Addendum` action
(`CMP-NABH-10`).

*Keyboard.* Tab order follows visual order. `Alt+S` save draft, `Alt+Shift+S`
sign, `Esc` closes the topmost overlay only. A full path to the primary action
without a mouse is mandatory — `P-03` and `P-21` work with a queue behind them.

**`ARC-01` · Worklist / queue — 34 screens**

*Layout.* `Z4` title, filter chips, sort control · `Z5` table with a sticky
header and a row-count line · `Z6` optional preview of the selected row.

*Canonical workflow.* 1 Load with the persona's default filter → 2 AI ranks
(`AIP-07`, `G0`/`G1`) with a per-row reason chip → 3 User scans, optionally
re-sorts → 4 Select a row → preview or navigate → 5 Act inline where the action
is single-step, else navigate.

*States.* `EMPTY` must say why the queue is empty and what would put something
in it. `PARTIAL` when one contributing source is down, with the row count
qualified. `AI-OFF` reverts to the deterministic sort **without** re-ordering
under the user mid-scan.

*⚠️ The reversibility rule.* Every AI-sorted worklist ships a one-click
deterministic sort, and the current sort is always named in the header. A
clinician who cannot get back to a predictable order stops trusting the list.

*Keyboard.* `↑`/`↓` move selection, `Enter` opens, `Space` previews, `/` focuses
filter. Selection survives a background refresh.

**`ARC-04` · Board / kanban — 14 screens**

Used for the bed board, ED tracker, OT board, discharge readiness, isolation and
TPA approval boards — the screens a client recognises as "the hospital".

*Layout.* `Z4` title, facility/ward scope, legend · `Z5` columns by state, cards
by entity. No `Z6`; detail opens in `Z8` or expands in place.

*Canonical workflow.* 1 Load scoped to the user's unit or facility → 2 Cards
carry an AI badge (`AIP-06`) → 3 Column headers carry counts and a capacity
signal → 4 User acts from the card menu, or drags where the state change is
legitimate → 5 ⚠️ **A drag that violates a hard rule is refused with an inline
reason on the target**, never silently reverted.

*States.* `PARTIAL` is the common case — one ward's feed is down while the rest
are live, and the board must say which. Auto-refresh with a visible "as of"
timestamp; `STALE` after 2× the refresh interval.

*⚠️ Hard rules are deterministic.* Gender mix, isolation category and payer bed
entitlement (`CMP-PMJAY-03`) disable the target with a stated reason. `AI-611`
ranks **within** the permitted set only.

**`ARC-12` · Command wall — 4 screens**

*Layout.* `Z5` only. No `Z1`, no `Z2`, no input affordances. Designed to be read
at 3–4 metres and to run unattended for a shift.

*Canonical workflow.* Read-only. Auto-refresh ≤5s for `S-18-01`, ≤30s for the
operational walls. A case or row escalates visually on breach; nothing requires
an interaction to stay correct.

*States.* `OFFLINE` and `STALE` are the load-bearing states here — a wall
showing confidently wrong data is worse than a wall showing none. A stale wall
dims and states its last-good timestamp in large type.

*⚠️ No motion beyond a value change.* A wall in peripheral vision must not
attract attention unless something actually happened. Also: **it must work on a
phone.** `P-35` and `P-37` read the same wall on a 5" screen at 02:00 — see
§10.4.

These are the T1 screens. They are ordered as a **single clinical day across one
hospital group**, using the §8 cast throughout, so the deck reads as one product
rather than a feature tour. Beats #28–#29 close on the assistant.

**Beats #28–#29 are the closer, and they are deliberately last.** Showing the
assistant *after* twenty-seven screens lands the point that it is on every one of
them, scoped to whoever is looking — rather than opening with a chatbot, which
reads as a novelty. ⚠️ Say out loud that the retrieval model is **not built yet**
(§6.1); a clinical audience trusts a roadmap more than a claim.

**The two beats that win the meeting** are #8 and #17–21. #8 is the only screen
where the AI is *wrong and is stopped* — it converts the AI story from a risk
into a reassurance, and a medical superintendent will remember it. #17–21 is the
flagship told as one patient's 90 minutes, which is the difference between a
product and a dashboard.

### §10.3 Deliverable format & naming

| Item | Convention |
|---|---|
| File name | `{screen-id}__{slug}__{state}.png` → `S-18-06__live-case-clock__default.png` |
| Frame name in the design tool | `{screen-id} · {Name} · {state}` |
| Canvas sizes | `1440×900` desktop · `1024×768` ward tablet · `390×844` phone · `1920×1080` wall |
| Theme | Light unless the screen is in §5.3's night-mandatory list |
| Data | §8 cast only. Fixed moment: Mon 21 Sep 2026, 08:40 IST |
| Annotation layer | Separate, toggleable; never baked into the export |

### §10.4 Definition of done for a screen mockup

A mockup is done when all of the following are true. This list exists so that
"done" is not a matter of opinion.

1. Every zone the specification names is present and sourced correctly —
   `GP-01`, `GP-02` and `GP-05` are **not** redrawn per screen.
2. Every ✅-required field from the field table is visible.
3. Every primary and secondary action is present, in the stated placement, with
   the stated enabled/disabled state shown.
4. **Every `◆AI-` touchpoint is visible**, with its affordance pattern, its
   confidence band and a `Why?` affordance. An AI touchpoint that is documented
   but not drawn is the most common failure of this deliverable.
4b. ⚠️ **The `GP-17` RAG help bar (`Z7b`) is present on every frame** except
   `ARC-12` walls — collapsed by default. The deck needs one frame with it
   expanded showing a cited answer, and one in `AI-ABSTAIN` (§6.1).
5. For T1: the states named in the spec's drawing notes are drawn as separate
   frames — at minimum `default` plus one of `AI-LOW` / `AI-ABSTAIN` /
   `BREAKGLASS` / `OFFLINE`, because the governed-AI and degrades-gracefully
   story is only visible in those frames.
6. Data is drawn from §8. No invented names, no `$`, no `MM/DD` dates, ₹ grouped
   Indian-style, and ⚠️ **no cash tender or denomination UI anywhere** (§2.1 A10).
7. Text passes contrast at ≥4.5:1 in the theme drawn.
8. `ARC-12` walls are checked at 25% zoom (the 4-metre proxy) **and** at phone
   width.
9. Touch targets ≥44px on any frame a gloved or mobile persona uses.
10. The frame is linked back to its screen ID in the registry, so §9 stays the
    index of what exists.

# Part 2 — Modules

27 modules in nine layers (§2.5). Every module follows the same ten-part
template, so a reader learns the shape once:

`M-xx.1` purpose & boundary · `M-xx.2` personas & permissions · `M-xx.3` entry
points & exits · `M-xx.4` screen inventory · `M-xx.5` AI capabilities ·
`M-xx.6` India & compliance · `M-xx.7` integration touchpoints · `M-xx.8` key
data entities · `M-xx.9` workflows · `M-xx.10` screen specifications.

Each module ends with a `<!-- /M-xx -->` fence, so `## M-07` … fence bounds the
module exactly (§1.8).

---

## M-01 · Platform, Tenancy & Facility Configuration

**In one line.** The group, its four facilities, and what is switched on where.

### M-01.1 Purpose & scope boundary

**Purpose.** Defines the tenancy spine every other module is scoped by: the
group, its facilities, their statutory registration records, the physical
inventory of wards, rooms and beds, the departments and services each facility
offers, and which modules and AI capabilities are enabled at each site. It also
owns the regulatory pack selection that makes `CMP-INTL-01` real.

**Does NOT cover.** Bed *state* — who is in a bed, and whether it is clean — is
`M-08`. Users and their permissions are `M-02`. Coded clinical vocabularies and
the charge master are `M-03`. Tariffs are `M-19`. Equipment as a maintainable
asset is `M-21`; this module only records that a room exists.

**⚠️ The distinction that is easiest to get wrong.** `M-01` owns *"bed 4B-12
exists, is a general-ward bed, and belongs to facility AWF"*. `M-08` owns
*"`SD-P-03` is in it, and it will be free at 14:00"*. Conflating configuration
with state is the most common structural error in hospital software, because the
two look identical on a bed board and behave completely differently under
concurrency.

**What the client will judge this module on.** Whether a four-hospital group
looks like one product with four facilities rather than four installations —
and whether switching facility is unmistakable enough that nobody charts on the
wrong site's patient.

### M-01.2 Personas & permissions

| Persona | What they do here | Owns screens | Scope | Density | Device |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `P-42` IT / System Administrator | All configuration | `S-01-01`…`S-01-06` | `group.admin` | Compact | Desktop |
| `P-02` Medical Superintendent | Reads facility profile, licences, service catalogue | — | `facility.read` | Comfortable | Desktop |
| `P-09` Bed Manager | Reads bed inventory; requests changes | — | `facility.read` | Compact | Desktop |

⚠️ `group.admin` confers **no clinical read** anywhere. An administrator who can
create a ward cannot open a chart — the `admin` verb never implies `read`
(§3.2).

### M-01.3 Entry points & exits

| Arrive from | Trigger | Lands on | Leaves to |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GP-02` nav rail ▸ Administration | Click | `S-01-01` | — |
| `GP-07` facility switcher ▸ Manage facilities | Click | `S-01-01` | Back to caller |
| `S-08-01` bed board ▸ "Bed not listed?" | Click | `S-01-03` | Back to `S-08-01` |
| `S-25-06` AI governance ▸ per-site enablement | Deep link | `S-01-05` | Back to `S-25-06` |

### M-01.5 AI capabilities in this module

| AI | Capability | Surfaces on | Pattern | Gate | Confidence | Explain | Guardrail |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AI-901` | NL record & cohort search | `S-01-01` | `AIP-04` | G1 | 3-band | On demand | Search only; returns nothing the caller cannot already read |

**Module AI narrative.** *"The platform notices when one hospital's setup has
drifted from the group standard — a ward with no isolation category, a service
enabled with no tariff — and tells you before it becomes a billing dispute. And
it watches every statutory licence's renewal date so a fire NOC never lapses
quietly."*

|---|---|---|---|

| `CMP-STAT-06` | CEA registration, fire NOC, PCB consent, lift, boiler | Licence register with renewal escalation on the facility profile | `S-01-02` |
| `CMP-ABDM-07` | HFR facility ID | HFR ID is a first-class field on the facility profile, not a note | `S-01-02` |
| `CMP-GST-05` | Public display of rates | The rate-display screen is a facility-level obligation | `S-01-02` → `S-04-11` |

|---|---|---|---|

| Identity provider (SSO) | **←** | OIDC / SAML | Configured here, enforced in `M-02` |
| Group finance / GL | **→** | File or API | Facility and cost-centre codes originate here |

| Entity | Shown as | Identifier format | Example (§8) |

| Facility | Facility card | 3-letter code | `AWF` |
| Ward | Ward row | `{code}` | `4B` |
| Bed | Bed row | `{ward}-{bed}` | `4B-12` |

### M-01.9 Workflows

#### W-01-1 · Commission a new facility

**Spine.** `S-01-01 → S-01-02 → S-01-03 → S-01-04 → S-01-06 → S-01-05`
**Trigger.** The group acquires or opens a hospital. **Actors.** `P-42` · `P-02`
**Terminal outcomes.** `O1` facility live · `O2` saved incomplete, not bookable

| # | Actor | Screen | What happens | AI | Next |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `P-42` | `S-01-01` | U: adds a facility with a 3-letter code. S: code uniqueness enforced group-wide | ◆AI-901 G1 | 2 |
| 2 | `P-42` | `S-01-02` | U: enters CEA registration, HFR ID, GSTIN, statutory licences. S: HFR ID **verified against the registry, not typed** | ◆AI-813 G1 | 3 |
| 3 | `P-42` | `S-01-03` | U: defines wards, rooms, beds, bed classes and isolation capability | ◆AI-903 G1 | 4 |
| 4 | `P-42` | `S-01-04` | U: enables departments and services | ◆AI-903 G1 | 5 |
| 5 | `P-42` | `S-01-06` | U: selects the regulatory pack (`IN-2026.1`). S: statutory set, formats, terminology bindings and required-field profile all switch together | ◆AI-903 G1 | 6? |
| 6? | — | `S-01-05` | **?** Are all prerequisites met | ◆AI-903 G1 | complete → 7 · gaps → 6! |
| 6! | `P-42` | `S-01-05` | **!** S: ⚠️ modules cannot be enabled while a prerequisite is missing — **each blocked module names what it needs** | ◆AI-903 G1 | 3 |
| 7 | `P-42` | `S-01-05` | U: enables modules and per-site AI capabilities | ◆AI-903 G1 | terminal `O1` |

#### W-01-2 · Configuration drift review

**Spine.** `S-01-01 → S-01-03`
**Trigger.** `AI-903` detects divergence from the group standard.

| # | Actor | Screen | What happens | AI | Next |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | — | `S-01-01` | S: flags drift — a ward with no isolation category, a service enabled with no tariff | ◆AI-903 `AIP-05` G1 | 2 |
| 2 | `P-42` | `S-01-03` | U: reviews and corrects. S: ⚠️ **never auto-applies a configuration change** | ◆AI-903 G1 | terminal |

### M-01.10 Screen specifications

#### S-01-01 · Group & Facility Directory

**One-liner.** The group's four facilities, and what each one is.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Route** | `/admin/facilities` |
| **Archetype** | `ARC-18` master · density compact |
| **Persona** | `P-42` |
| **Permission** | `group.admin`. ⚠️ Confers **no clinical read** — an administrator who creates a ward cannot open a chart. |
| **Entry** | `GP-02` ▸ Administration · `GP-07` switcher ▸ Manage facilities |
| **Exit** | Row → `S-01-02` · ▸ Beds → `S-01-03` · ▸ Features → `S-01-05` |
| **In workflows** | `W-01-1` s1 · `W-01-2` s1 |
| **AI** | ◆AI-901 |
| **Tier / status** | T3 · ✅ |

**Zones.** `Z1` `Z2` — `GP-01`, `GP-02`, no deviation · `Z3` — n/a: not patient-scoped · `Z4` — search, `effective on` date picker, add · `Z5` — `C-19` table with effective-dated rows · `Z8` — `C-12` add/edit modal · `Z7b` — `GP-17` assistant bubble, no deviation (§6.1)

**Table columns.** Code · name · city · role (hub / secondary / spoke) · beds · regulatory pack · modules enabled · status

**Actions.**

| Action | Placement | Style | Enabled when | On activate | Confirm |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Add facility | `Z4` | primary | `group.admin` | opens `C-12`; 3-letter code uniqueness enforced group-wide | none |
| Open | row click | primary | `group.admin` | → `S-01-02` | none |
| Deactivate | row menu | destructive | `group.admin` | ⚠️ blocked while any open encounter exists, with the count shown | ⚠️ modal naming the blocker |

**AI touchpoints.**

| AI | Capability | Pattern | Gate | Explain | Guardrail |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AI-901` | Natural-language record & cohort search | `AIP-04` | G1 | 3-band | On demand |
| `AI-911` | Contextual assistant | `AIP-04` | G1 | ⚠️ Mandatory, cited | §6.1 — never clinical, grounded or silent |

**States.**

| Code | What to draw |
|---|---|
| `LOADING` | `C-45` skeleton matching the loaded geometry; `Z7a` disabled |
| `EMPTY` | ⚠️ never legitimately empty — a group has at least one facility, so an empty list is `ERROR` |
| `PARTIAL` | the failed region names what is missing and since when; the rest stays usable |
| `ERROR` | recoverable, input preserved, retry plus an escape hatch |
| `VALIDATION` | problem count, inline errors, focus to the first, primary stays disabled |
| `DENIED` | `C-36` panel — what is missing, who grants it, request action. ⚠️ **no patient data on screen** |
| `BREAKGLASS` | `GP-10` amber banner, reason before content renders, "logged and reviewed" |
| `OFFLINE` | `C-37` strip — what works, what is queued, what is blocked; typed content never lost |
| `STALE` | timestamp turns amber, "Data as of HH:MM · Refresh" |
| `SAVING` | primary disabled with a spinner; content not locked |
| `LOCKED` | read-only naming who holds it and since when, plus the legitimate next action |
| `AI-OFF` | every `◆` affordance **hidden, not greyed**; the `Z7b` bubble hidden; one quiet line; screen fully usable |
| `AI-ABSTAIN` | states what is missing and the action that would fix it; **never a null or zero score** |
| `AI-LOW` | delivered collapsed with an amber band; acceptance blocked until expanded |

**Responsive.** ≥1280 full table · 1024–1279 fewer columns · <768 ⚠️ read-only — master-data editing is not a phone task

**Keyboard.** `/` search · `n` new · `Enter` edits the focused row.

**Accessibility.** Every `◆` region is `role="region"` with the confidence band in its accessible name — never colour alone. · Clinical status carries an icon **and** text (§5.3); abnormal reads `↑ High`, not a red cell. · Contrast ≥4.5:1 in both themes; touch targets ≥44px.

**Sample data.** `SD-F-01` … `SD-F-04` per §8.1.

**Drawing notes.** Show all four facilities with bed counts — the multi-hospital story in one frame. · ⚠️ Mark `SD-F-04` as having no CT so the stroke-network constraint is visible from the top.

## M-02 · Identity, Access, Roles & Consent

**In one line.** Who is calling, what they may do, and what the patient has
agreed to.

### M-02.1 Purpose & scope boundary

**Purpose.** The single authority for authentication, capability-based
authorization, role-record management, break-glass access and its review, and
the patient consent register — including ABDM consent artefacts. No other module
implements login, token issuance, permission evaluation or consent storage.

**Does NOT cover.** *Clinical* privileging — whether Dr Kulkarni may perform
thrombectomy — is an HR fact owned by `M-23`; this module **reads** it and turns
it into an authorization input (§2.6, declared exception). Audit storage and the
audit read path are `M-24`. Patient demographics are `M-04`.

**⚠️ Three rules this module enforces and no screen may work around**
(§3.2): enforcement reads **capabilities, never role names** · every decision is
inside a **subject scope** · **default is deny**, evaluated at request time.
These carry `DEC-003` from the existing corpus unchanged (§E).

**What the client will judge this module on.** Whether a consultant can get to a
chart at 02:00 without a phone call to IT — and whether the hospital can prove,
afterwards, exactly who looked at what.

### M-02.2 Personas & permissions

| Persona | What they do here | Owns screens | Scope | Density | Device |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `P-42` IT Administrator | Users, roles, capability design | `S-02-02`…`S-02-04` | `iam.admin` | Compact | Desktop |
| `P-43` Data Protection Officer | Break-glass review, consent, rights requests | `S-02-06`…`S-02-08` | `dpo.read`, `consent.admin` | Comfortable | Desktop |
| `P-25` Quality Manager | Break-glass review (joint with DPO) | — | `breakglass.review` | Comfortable | Desktop |
| `P-04`, `P-35` Clinicians | Request break-glass | `S-02-05` | `relationship` or break-glass | Compact | Any |
| `P-03` Front Office | Capture consent | — | `consent.write` | Compact | Desktop |
| All | Sign in | `S-02-01` | — | — | Any |

| `NTF-28` break-glass used | Deep link | `S-02-06` | — |

### M-02.5 AI capabilities in this module

| AI | Capability | Surfaces on | Pattern | Gate | Confidence | Explain | Guardrail |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AI-908` | Access-pattern anomaly & break-glass review assist | `S-02-01`…`S-02-06` | `AIP-07`, `AIP-06` | G1 | 3-band | Mandatory | ⚠️ **Never blocks access and never authorizes it.** Ranks a review queue only — no fact from it may enter an authorization decision |
| `AI-907` | Master-data deduplication | `S-02-02` | `AIP-03` | G2 | 3-band | Mandatory | Suggests duplicate staff records; a merge is always human |
| `AI-112` | Structured extraction from free text | `S-02-07` | `AIP-02` | G2 | 3-band | Mandatory | Extracts consent scope from a scanned form; the clinician confirms |
| `AI-905` | ABDM publish-failure classification | `S-02-08` | `AIP-06` | G2 | 3-band | On demand | Classification only |

**⚠️ The constraint worth stating loudly.** `AI-908` ranks a *review* queue. It
may not gate a login, refuse a request, or contribute to any authorization
decision — a return path from anomaly detection into authority would reconstruct
exactly the relationship-existence oracle that §3.2's uniform-refusal rule
exists to prevent. This carries `DEC-009` K-7 unchanged.

**Module AI narrative.** *"Break-glass is normal in a hospital — at 2am someone
will need a chart they have no prior relationship with. What matters is that
every one of those accesses is reviewed, and the review queue is ranked so your
DPO looks at the twelve that matter instead of the four hundred that don't."*

## M-03 · Master Data, Terminology & Interoperability

**In one line.** The coded vocabularies every other module binds to, and the
wire to the outside world.

### M-03.1 Purpose & scope boundary

**Purpose.** Owns the terminology service (ICD-10/11, SNOMED CT, LOINC,
NAMASTE), the code-set mapping workbench, the service and charge master, the drug
formulary master, and the whole external interface surface — FHIR R4 publish and
subscribe, HL7 v2 for legacy ADT/ORU/ORM, the ABDM publish queue, and the
downtime reconciliation console.

**Does NOT cover.** Tariffs and prices are `M-19` — this module owns that a
service *exists* and how it is *coded*, not what it costs. Drug stock and batches
are `M-16`/`M-21`. Clinical content authored against these codes belongs to the
authoring module.

**⚠️ The clinical-mastery inversion.** The existing corpus's clinical adapter was
**read-only** from an external EHR, and explicitly forbade a write method while
its `OQ-047` stayed open. In a hospital product that question is answered: **the
hospital masters the record.** The adapter therefore keeps a read path for
*outside* data and gains a **publish** path — it does not gain a write path into
the hospital's own record, because there is no upstream to write to. See `DD-004`
and §E.

**What the client will judge this module on.** Whether their existing HIS can
keep running during a phased migration, and whether ABDM publishing actually
works — including a visible, retryable queue when it does not.

### M-03.2 Personas & permissions

| Persona | What they do here | Owns screens | Scope | Density | Device |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `P-42` IT Administrator | Interfaces, replay, downtime reconciliation | `S-03-05`…`S-03-08` | `integration.admin` | Compact | Desktop |

### M-03.5 AI capabilities in this module

| AI | Capability | Surfaces on | Pattern | Gate | Confidence | Explain | Guardrail |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AI-906` | Terminology mapping suggestion | `S-03-01`, `S-03-02` | `AIP-02`, `AIP-03` | G2 | 3-band | Mandatory | A mapping is never auto-committed; a wrong map corrupts coding and claims downstream |
| `AI-907` | Master-data deduplication | `S-03-03`, `S-03-04` | `AIP-03` | G2 | 3-band | Mandatory | Suggests merges; the merge is human and reversible |
| `AI-904` | Interface failure detection & triage | `S-03-05`, `S-03-06` | `AIP-07`, `AIP-05` | G1 | 3-band | Mandatory | Ranks and explains; replay is always an explicit human action |
| `AI-905` | ABDM publish-failure classification | `S-03-07` | `AIP-06`, `AIP-03` | G2 | 3-band | Mandatory | Classifies and proposes a fix; **bulk retry requires confirmation** |

**Module AI narrative.** *"Mapping your existing codes to national standards is
normally a six-month project. The system proposes every mapping with its
reasoning and your coder confirms them in batches — and when an ABDM publish
fails, it tells you why in plain language instead of leaving a stack trace in a
log."*

### M-03.6 India & compliance overlay

| CMP | Obligation | UI consequence | Screens |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CMP-ABDM-03` | HIP publish of 5 record types | Per-record-type status, not one global flag | `S-03-07` |
| `CMP-ABDM-04` | Publish failures visible and retryable | Dedicated failure queue with reason classification | `S-03-07` |
| `CMP-INTL-02` | FHIR R4 external; HL7 v2 legacy | Interface monitor is standard-agnostic | `S-03-05`, `S-03-06` |
| `CMP-INTL-03` | Terminology bindings are configuration | Per-field binding point; pack change re-binds without a release | `S-03-01`, `S-03-02` |
| `CMP-GST-03` | HSN / SAC per line | Field on the charge master | `S-03-03` |
| `CMP-DRUG-03` | DPCO ceiling and NLEM flags | Formulary carries ceiling price and NLEM status | `S-03-04` |

### M-03.7 Integration touchpoints

| System | Dir | Standard | UI consequence |
|---|---|---|---|
| ABDM HIP / HIU | **↔** | FHIR R4 Bundle | Publish queue with per-type status; async, with a stated cap then `STALE` |
| Incumbent HIS | **↔** | HL7 v2 ADT/ORU/ORM | Coexistence during migration; message trace shows either standard |
| NHCX | **→** | FHIR-based claim | Owned by `M-20`; the wire is here |
| Analysers, modalities, devices | **←** | HL7 v2 ORU, DICOM, device gateway | Values arrive with a `source` chip and timestamp |
| Group GL | **→** | File / API | Outbound posting from `M-19` |

### M-03.9 Workflows

#### W-03-1 · Map incumbent codes to national standards

**Spine.** `S-03-01 → S-03-02 → S-03-03`

| # | Actor | Screen | What happens | AI | Next |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `P-24` | `S-03-01` | U: loads the incumbent code set | ◆AI-906 G2 | 2 |
| 2 | — | `S-03-02` | S: proposes a mapping per code with confidence and reasoning; LOW-confidence items arrive **collapsed** | ◆AI-906 `AIP-02` G2 | 3 |
| 3 | `P-24` | `S-03-02` | U: confirms in batches. S: ⚠️ **never auto-commits** — a wrong map corrupts coding and claims downstream | ◆AI-906 G2 | 4? |
| 4? | — | `S-03-02` | **?** Any code unmappable | ◆AI-906 | unmappable → 4! · all mapped → 5 |
| 4! | `P-24` | `S-03-01` | **!** S: parks it as `⊘ unmapped` with a reason; **never silently dropped** | — | 5 |
| 5 | `P-21` | `S-03-03` | S: mapped services appear on the charge master awaiting a price from `M-19` | ◆AI-907 G2 | terminal |

#### W-03-2 · ABDM publish failure triage

**Spine.** `S-03-07 → S-03-06`
**Trigger.** A FHIR publish fails after a clinical record is signed.
**⚠️ Governing rule.** The clinical record is **unaffected** by a publish
failure. Publishing is downstream of care, never a gate on it.

| # | Actor | Screen | What happens | AI | Next |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | — | `S-03-07` | S: failure lands in the queue, classified in plain language — expired consent, malformed bundle, registry down | ◆AI-905 `AIP-06` G2 | 2? |
| 2? | `P-42` | `S-03-07` | **?** Cause class | ◆AI-905 G2 | transient → 3 · data → 4 · consent → 5 |
| 3 | `P-42` | `S-03-07` | U: retries. S: ⚠️ **bulk retry requires confirmation** | ◆AI-905 G2 | terminal |
| 4 | `P-24` | `S-03-06` | U: inspects the message trace, corrects the source record, republishes | ◆AI-904 G1 | terminal |
| 5 | `P-43` | `S-02-08` | S: no consent → ⚠️ the record is **held**, not discarded and not published | ◆AI-905 G2 | terminal |

#### W-03-3 · Downtime and reconciliation

**Spine.** `S-03-08`
**Trigger.** Connectivity or power loss at a site — ⚠️ **normal, not exceptional**
(§2.1 A9, `DD-015`).

| # | Actor | Screen | What happens | AI | Next |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | — | — | S: `GP-12` offline strip appears everywhere, stating what works, what is queued and what is blocked | — | 2 |
| 2 | staff | — | U: continues on downtime forms; local capture queues | — | 3 |
| 3 | `P-42` | `S-03-08` | S: on reconnect, a two-column reconciliation of queued vs server state | ◆AI-904 `AIP-02` G2 | 4? |
| 4? | — | `S-03-08` | **?** Conflicts | ◆AI-904 | conflicts → 4! · clean → terminal |
| 4! | `P-42` | `S-03-08` | **!** U: resolves each. S: ⚠️ **clinical timestamps are reconciled against the server clock, never overwritten by the local one** (`DD-012`) | ◆AI-904 G2 | terminal |

### M-03.10 Screen specifications

#### S-03-01 · Terminology Browser

**One-liner.** Browsing the coded vocabularies every clinical field binds to.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Route** | `/admin/terminology` |
| **Archetype** | `ARC-17` search · density compact |
| **Persona** | `P-24` · `P-42` |
| **Permission** | `terminology.write` for `P-24`; read for everyone with a coded field. |
| **Entry** | `GP-02` ▸ Masters ▸ Terminology · any coded field ▸ "Code not found" · `S-01-06` pack change |
| **Exit** | ▸ Map → `S-03-02` · back to the calling field with the code selected |
| **In workflows** | `W-03-1` s1,4! |
| **AI** | ◆AI-906 |
| **Tier / status** | T3 · ✅ |

**Zones.** `Z1` `Z2` — `GP-01`, `GP-02`, no deviation · `Z3` — n/a: not patient-scoped · `Z4` — search box and scope selector · `Z5` — results with the matched fields highlighted · `Z7b` — `GP-17` assistant bubble, no deviation (§6.1)

**Table columns.** System · code · display · hierarchy · bound fields · pack · status

**Actions.**

| Action | Placement | Style | Enabled when | On activate | Confirm |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Search | `Z4` | primary | always | cross-system search with hierarchy shown | none |
| Select for field | row | primary | opened from a field | returns the code to the caller | none |
| Request a code | `Z4` | secondary | `terminology.write` | ⚠️ parks it as `⊘ unmapped` with a reason — never silently dropped | none |

**AI touchpoints.**

| AI | Capability | Pattern | Gate | Explain | Guardrail |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AI-906` | Terminology mapping suggestion | `AIP-02`, `AIP-03` | G2 | 3-band | Mandatory |
| `AI-911` | Contextual assistant | `AIP-04` | G1 | ⚠️ Mandatory, cited | §6.1 — never clinical, grounded or silent |

**States.**

| Code | What to draw |
|---|---|
| `LOADING` | `C-45` skeleton matching the loaded geometry; `Z7a` disabled |
| `EMPTY` | explains why it is empty and the action that would change that |
| `PARTIAL` | the failed region names what is missing and since when; the rest stays usable |
| `ERROR` | recoverable, input preserved, retry plus an escape hatch |
| `VALIDATION` | problem count, inline errors, focus to the first, primary stays disabled |
| `DENIED` | `C-36` panel — what is missing, who grants it, request action. ⚠️ **no patient data on screen** |
| `BREAKGLASS` | `GP-10` amber banner, reason before content renders, "logged and reviewed" |
| `OFFLINE` | `C-37` strip — what works, what is queued, what is blocked; typed content never lost |
| `STALE` | timestamp turns amber, "Data as of HH:MM · Refresh" |
| `SAVING` | primary disabled with a spinner; content not locked |
| `LOCKED` | read-only naming who holds it and since when, plus the legitimate next action |
| `AI-OFF` | every `◆` affordance **hidden, not greyed**; the `Z7b` bubble hidden; one quiet line; screen fully usable |
| `AI-ABSTAIN` | states what is missing and the action that would fix it; **never a null or zero score** |
| `AI-LOW` | delivered collapsed with an amber band; acceptance blocked until expanded |

**Responsive.** ≥1024 results table · <1024 result cards · <768 full-screen search

**Keyboard.** `/` focuses · `↑`/`↓` move · `Enter` selects. Typing is never blocked by an in-flight query.

**Accessibility.** Every `◆` region is `role="region"` with the confidence band in its accessible name — never colour alone. · Clinical status carries an icon **and** text (§5.3); abnormal reads `↑ High`, not a red cell. · Contrast ≥4.5:1 in both themes; touch targets ≥44px.

**Sample data.** ICD-10 `J18.9`, SNOMED pneumonia, NAMASTE AYUSH codes per §8.5.

**Drawing notes.** Show the binding point per field so a designer sees which system applies where. · ⚠️ Include a NAMASTE example — AYUSH coding is an India-specific expectation.

#### S-03-05 · Interface Monitor

**One-liner.** Is anything broken between us and the outside world?

## M-04 · Front Office, Registration, ABHA & Patient Index

**In one line.** The first sixty seconds of every patient's visit.

### M-04.1 Purpose & scope boundary

**Purpose.** Everything that happens at the counter and the kiosk: finding an
existing patient or creating a new one, ABHA creation and linkage, Scan & Share
arrival, demographics, opening a visit or encounter, attendant passes, MLC
registration, enquiry and estimate, and the public rate display. It owns the
**enterprise patient index** — the guarantee that one human being is one patient
record across all four facilities.

**Does NOT cover.** Appointments and queueing are `M-05`. Billing and collection
are `M-19`; this module produces an *estimate*, not an invoice. Consent capture
is `M-02`. Clinical intake is `M-06` or `M-07`.

**⚠️ The rule the whole module turns on.** A duplicate patient record is not an
inconvenience — it splits a clinical history, breaks ABDM linkage, and produces
two bills. Indian names transliterate inconsistently (`Lakshmanan` /
`Laxmanan` / `Lakshmanan R`), so identity matching is a first-class, AI-assisted,
human-confirmed workflow (`AI-602`) and not a fuzzy search box.

**What the client will judge this module on.** Registration time for a
walk-in — can a returning patient with an ABHA QR be through the counter without
anyone typing — and whether the duplicate rate actually falls.

### M-04.2 Personas & permissions

| Persona | What they do here | Owns screens | Scope | Density | Device |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `P-03` Front Office Executive | All counter work | `S-04-01`, `S-04-03`…`S-04-11` | `facility`, `registration.write` | **Compact** | Desktop, dual-screen |
| `P-33` Patient | Self-service arrival | `S-04-02` | `self` | Comfortable | Kiosk, phone |
| `P-24` MRD Officer | Duplicate merge | `S-04-05` | `facility`, `patient.merge` | Compact | Desktop |
| `P-06` Emergency Physician | Unidentified / MLC registration | — | `facility` | Compact | ED workstation |

⚠️ `P-03` holds `registration.write` but **no clinical read**. A front-office
user can register `SD-P-03` and cannot open his chart.

### M-04.3 Entry points & exits

| Arrive from | Trigger | Lands on | Leaves to |
|---|---|---|---|
| Shift start | Default landing for `P-03` | `S-04-01` | — |
| Kiosk QR scan | Patient action | `S-04-02` | `S-05-03` token issued |
| `S-04-01` ▸ New patient | Click | `S-04-03` | `S-04-08` visit opening |
| `S-04-01` ▸ Search | `/` or click | `S-04-04` | `S-04-06` or `S-04-08` |
| `AI-602` duplicate flagged | `AIP-05` banner | `S-04-05` | Back to caller |
| `S-07-01` ED ▸ unidentified arrival | Handoff | `S-04-10` | `S-07-02` triage |
| Phone enquiry | `P-03` action | `S-04-11` | Printed estimate |

### M-04.5 AI capabilities in this module

| AI | Capability | Surfaces on | Pattern | Gate | Confidence | Explain | Guardrail |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AI-601` | Front-office queue & load forecast | `S-04-01` | `AIP-06` | G0 | None (G0) | On demand | Display only; never reorders a physical queue |
| `AI-602` | ⚠️ Identity matching & duplicate detection | `S-04-03`…`S-04-05`, `S-07-07` | `AIP-03`, `AIP-09` | **G2** | 3-band | **Mandatory** — shows which fields matched | ⚠️ **A merge is never automatic.** Falls back to deterministic search on name + phone + ABHA |
| `AI-604` | Registration field prediction & autofill | `S-04-03`, `S-04-06` | `AIP-02` | G2 | 3-band | On demand | Every prefilled field is visibly marked and editable |
| `AI-113` | Document intelligence — OCR of cards & records | `S-04-03` | `AIP-02` | G2 | 3-band | Mandatory | Reads Aadhaar, ABHA, insurance and scheme cards; human confirms every field |
| `AI-110` | Translation & name transliteration | `S-04-06` | `AIP-02` | G2 | 3-band | On demand | Stores Latin **and** native script (§5.4 rule 4) |
| `AI-702` | ABHA Scan & Share assist | `S-04-02`, `S-04-07` | `AIP-02` | G2 | 3-band | On demand | Manual ABHA entry always available |
| `AI-711` | Kiosk guidance & wayfinding | `S-04-02` | `AIP-10`, `AIP-02` | G0 | None | — | Printed signage remains the fallback |
| `AI-603` | Encounter type & department routing | `S-04-08` | `AIP-02` | G2 | 3-band | Mandatory | Suggests; `P-03` confirms |
| `AI-507` | Payer eligibility & scheme matching | `S-04-08` | `AIP-03` | G2 | 3-band | Mandatory | ⚠️ Eligibility is **verified** against the payer, never inferred |
| `AI-503` | Estimate & package cost prediction | `S-04-11` | `AIP-02` | G1 | 3-band | Mandatory | The rate card is deterministic; only the *quantity* forecast is predicted |
| `AI-504` | Tariff & ward-class rate resolution | `S-04-11` | `AIP-02` | G2 | 3-band | Mandatory | ⚠️ Rate lookup is deterministic — never AI-decided |
| `AI-810` | Medico-legal documentation completeness | `S-04-10` | `AIP-05` | G1 | 3-band | Mandatory | Flags missing MLC fields; never files on the user's behalf |
| `AI-712` | Family & attendant communication summary | `S-04-09` | `AIP-02` | G2 | 3-band | On demand | — |
| `AI-901` | NL record & cohort search | `S-04-04` | `AIP-04` | G1 | 3-band | On demand | Returns nothing the caller cannot already read |

**Module AI narrative.** *"A returning patient scans her ABHA at the kiosk and
walks to the doctor — nobody typed anything. And when a new patient's name has
been spelled three different ways across your four hospitals, the system finds
all three and asks your MRD officer to confirm the merge instead of quietly
creating a fourth."*

### M-04.6 India & compliance overlay

| CMP | Obligation | UI consequence | Screens |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CMP-ABDM-01` | ABHA linked to the record | `abha` field type; `GP-09` four-state chip | `S-04-03`, `S-04-07` |
| `CMP-ABDM-06` | Scan & Share token without typing | Kiosk QR screen; `arrived via Scan & Share` state | `S-04-02` |
| `CMP-STAT-01` | ⚠️ MLC registration + police intimation with acknowledgement | MLC number; intimation memo; acknowledgement captured, not assumed | `S-04-10` |
| `CMP-STAT-05` | Unidentified patient process | Identity-pending state that **does not block care** | `S-07-07` |
| `CMP-GST-05` | Public display of rates | A public-facing rate list screen | `S-04-11` |
| `CMP-PMJAY-06` | Scheme referral / permission letter | Letter upload + validity; ESIC IP number validated | `S-04-08` |
| `CMP-DPDP-02` | Consent notice in the patient's language | Notice at registration per `GP-08` | `S-04-03` |

| AI | Capability | Pattern | Gate | Explain | Guardrail |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

**States.**

| Code | What to draw |
|---|---|
| `LOADING` | `C-45` skeleton matching the loaded geometry; `Z7a` disabled |
| `EMPTY` | explains why it is empty and the action that would change that |
| `PARTIAL` | the failed region names what is missing and since when; the rest stays usable |

| `OFFLINE` | `C-37` strip — what works, what is queued, what is blocked; typed content never lost |

| `SAVING` | primary disabled with a spinner; content not locked |
| `LOCKED` | read-only naming who holds it and since when, plus the legitimate next action |
| `AI-OFF` | every `◆` affordance **hidden, not greyed**; the `Z7b` bubble hidden; one quiet line; screen fully usable |
| `AI-ABSTAIN` | states what is missing and the action that would fix it; **never a null or zero score** |
| `AI-LOW` | delivered collapsed with an amber band; acceptance blocked until expanded |

**Responsive.** ≥1440 4 columns · 1024–1439 2 columns · <768 1 column, priority order

**Keyboard.** `Enter` drills into the focused tile · `r` refreshes.

**Accessibility.** Every `◆` region is `role="region"` with the confidence band in its accessible name — never colour alone. · Clinical status carries an icon **and** text (§5.3); abnormal reads `↑ High`, not a red cell. · Contrast ≥4.5:1 in both themes; touch targets ≥44px.

**Sample data.** `SD-F-01` at 08:40: 34 waiting, 6 counters open, predicted peak 11:00, 4 Scan & Share arrivals.

**Drawing notes.** ⚠️ Draw the **predicted peak** beside the live count — a forecast is the differentiator; a live count is table stakes. · Include a Scan & Share arrivals tile so the ABDM story starts on the first screen a client sees. · Keyboard hints visible — there is a queue behind this user.

#### S-04-05 · Duplicate Merge Workbench

**One-liner.** Two records, one person — and a merge nobody can do by accident.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Route** | `/patients/merge` |
| **Archetype** | `ARC-09` recon · density compact |
| **Persona** | `P-24` · `P-03` |
| **Permission** | `patient.merge` @ `facility` — ⚠️ `P-24` MRD, not front office. |
| **Entry** | `S-04-03` duplicate flagged · `S-04-04` ▸ Possible duplicate · `S-07-07` identity resolved |
| **Exit** | Merge → the surviving record · Reject → both kept, marked as reviewed |
| **In workflows** | `W-04-1` s2a · `W-04-2` s4 · `W-04-3` s5 |
| **AI** | ◆AI-602 |
| **Tier / status** | T3 · ✅ |

**Zones.** `Z1` `Z2` — `GP-01`, `GP-02`, no deviation · `Z3` — n/a: not patient-scoped · `Z4` — source labels, match summary · `Z5` — two columns side by side with per-row match state · `Z7a` — commit bar · `Z7b` — `GP-17` assistant bubble, no deviation (§6.1)

**Table columns.** Field · record A · record B · proposed survivor · conflict

**Actions.**

| Action | Placement | Style | Enabled when | On activate | Confirm |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Accept merge | `Z7a` | primary | a survivor is chosen and every conflict resolved | ⚠️ merges and is **reversible**; clinical history is carried, never re-keyed | ⚠️ modal listing what moves |
| Reject — different people | `Z7a` left | secondary | `patient.merge` | marks both as reviewed-distinct; ⚠️ stops re-flagging | ⚠️ modal |
| Choose survivor | column header | primary | always | switches which UHID persists | none |
| Resolve field | per conflicting row | primary | rows differ | picks a value per field | none |

**AI touchpoints.**

| AI | Capability | Pattern | Gate | Explain | Guardrail |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AI-602` | Patient identity matching & duplicate detection | `AIP-03`, `AIP-09` | **G2** | 3-band | **Mandatory** — shows which fields matched |
| `AI-911` | Contextual assistant | `AIP-04` | G1 | ⚠️ Mandatory, cited | §6.1 — never clinical, grounded or silent |

**States.**

| Code | What to draw |
|---|---|
| `LOADING` | `C-45` skeleton matching the loaded geometry; `Z7a` disabled |
| `EMPTY` | explains why it is empty and the action that would change that |
| `PARTIAL` | the failed region names what is missing and since when; the rest stays usable |
| `ERROR` | recoverable, input preserved, retry plus an escape hatch |
| `VALIDATION` | problem count, inline errors, focus to the first, primary stays disabled |
| `DENIED` | `C-36` panel — what is missing, who grants it, request action. ⚠️ **no patient data on screen** |
| `BREAKGLASS` | `GP-10` amber banner, reason before content renders, "logged and reviewed" |
| `OFFLINE` | `C-37` strip — what works, what is queued, what is blocked; typed content never lost |
| `STALE` | timestamp turns amber, "Data as of HH:MM · Refresh" |
| `SAVING` | primary disabled with a spinner; content not locked |
| `LOCKED` | read-only naming who holds it and since when, plus the legitimate next action |
| `AI-OFF` | every `◆` affordance **hidden, not greyed**; the `Z7b` bubble hidden; one quiet line; screen fully usable |
| `AI-ABSTAIN` | states what is missing and the action that would fix it; **never a null or zero score** |
| `AI-LOW` | delivered collapsed with an amber band; acceptance blocked until expanded |

**Responsive.** ≥1280 side by side · <1280 stacked pairs, one row at a time. ⚠️ Never two columns below 1024 — comparison becomes unreadable

**Keyboard.** `↑`/`↓` move rows · `m` accept the proposed match · `u` unmatch.

**Accessibility.** Every `◆` region is `role="region"` with the confidence band in its accessible name — never colour alone. · Clinical status carries an icon **and** text (§5.3); abnormal reads `↑ High`, not a red cell. · Contrast ≥4.5:1 in both themes; touch targets ≥44px.

**Sample data.** `SD-P-03` "R. Lakshmanan" `AWF-0044120` vs "Laxmanan R" `IHY-0091133` — same phone, different ABHA state.

**Drawing notes.** ⚠️ Draw the **two-column match with per-field resolution** and the matched-field evidence at the top. · State that the merge is reversible — irreversibility is why staff avoid merging and why duplicates persist.

## M-05 · Appointments, OP Queue & Scheduling

**In one line.** Getting the right patient in front of the right clinician at a
knowable time.

### M-05.1 Purpose & scope boundary

**Purpose.** Clinician session templates, appointment booking across channels
(counter, app, phone, referral), the live outpatient queue and token board,
leave and block management, referral intake, health-checkup package booking,
waitlist and recall, and the capacity console that decides overbooking policy.

**Does NOT cover.** OT scheduling is `M-11`, modality scheduling is `M-15`,
dialysis slots are `M-17`, and staff rostering is `M-23`. Those are
*resource* schedulers with different constraints; this module schedules
**clinician sessions**. Teleconsult booking is `M-27`, which reuses this
module's slot engine.

**What the client will judge this module on.** Whether the waiting-room
experience changes — a token board that predicts a realistic time rather than
counting a queue, and a no-show rate that overbooking actually absorbs.

### M-05.2 Personas & permissions

| `P-04` Consultant | Own templates, leave, blocks; reads own queue | `S-05-04`, `S-05-05` | `self`, `unit` | Compact | Tablet |
| `P-02` Administrator | Capacity and overbooking policy | `S-05-09` | `facility.admin` | Comfortable | Desktop |
| `P-33` Patient | Self-booking | — (uses `S-26-02`) | `self` | Comfortable | Phone |
| `P-44` Referring Doctor | Sends a referral | — | External, scoped | Comfortable | Phone |

### M-05.5 AI capabilities in this module

| AI | Capability | Surfaces on | Pattern | Gate | Confidence | Explain | Guardrail |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AI-605` | Appointment slot recommendation | `S-05-01`, `S-05-02`, `S-05-08` | `AIP-03` | G1 | 3-band | Mandatory | All open slots remain browsable; the recommendation never hides availability |
| `AI-606` | No-show prediction | `S-05-02`, `S-05-09` | `AIP-06` | G1 | 3-band | Mandatory | ⚠️ **Never used to refuse or deprioritise a patient** — only to set overbooking and reminder intensity |
| `AI-607` | OP queue wait-time prediction | `S-05-03` | `AIP-06` | G0 | None (G0) | On demand | Predicts a time; **never reorders the physical queue** |
| `AI-601` | Front-office queue & load forecast | `S-05-03` | `AIP-06` | G0 | None | On demand | Display only |
| `AI-608` | Clinician capacity & template optimisation | `S-05-01`, `S-05-04`, `S-05-05`, `S-05-09` | `AIP-03` | G1 | 3-band | Mandatory | Proposes template changes; the clinician's own template always wins |
| `AI-609` | Referral triage & routing | `S-05-06` | `AIP-07` | G2 | 3-band | Mandatory | Ranks and routes; a human accepts. Deterministic sort always available |
| `AI-503` | Estimate & package cost prediction | `S-05-07` | `AIP-02` | G1 | 3-band | Mandatory | — |
| `AI-710` | Appointment self-service assist | `S-05-08` | `AIP-04` | G1 | 3-band | On demand | — |

**⚠️ The `AI-606` constraint is an ethics question, not a technical one.** A
no-show score must never make a patient harder to book — that would
systematically disadvantage the poorest patients, who are the most likely to miss
an appointment for reasons of transport and wages. The score sets *overbooking
and reminder intensity* only, and `S-05-09` states that on the screen.

**Module AI narrative.** *"The token board tells a patient 'about 40 minutes',
and it is right, because it knows this consultant runs 12 minutes long on
Mondays. And your overbooking is set by predicted no-shows per session instead of
a flat 10% that is wrong twice a day."*

| AI | Capability | Pattern | Gate | Explain | Guardrail |

**States.**

| Code | What to draw |
|---|---|
| `LOADING` | `C-45` skeleton matching the loaded geometry; `Z7a` disabled |
| `EMPTY` | explains why it is empty and the action that would change that |
| `PARTIAL` | a display-board outage is shown as a named state, not hidden — the room is looking at that board |
| `ERROR` | recoverable, input preserved, retry plus an escape hatch |

| `LOCKED` | read-only naming who holds it and since when, plus the legitimate next action |
| `AI-OFF` | every `◆` affordance **hidden, not greyed**; the `Z7b` bubble hidden; one quiet line; screen fully usable |
| `AI-ABSTAIN` | states what is missing and the action that would fix it; **never a null or zero score** |
| `AI-LOW` | delivered collapsed with an amber band; acceptance blocked until expanded |

| `BREAKGLASS` | `GP-10` amber banner, reason before content renders, "logged and reviewed" |
| `OFFLINE` | `C-37` strip — what works, what is queued, what is blocked; typed content never lost |
| `STALE` | timestamp turns amber, "Data as of HH:MM · Refresh" |
| `SAVING` | primary disabled with a spinner; content not locked |
| `LOCKED` | read-only naming who holds it and since when, plus the legitimate next action |
| `AI-OFF` | every `◆` affordance **hidden, not greyed**; the `Z7b` bubble hidden; one quiet line; screen fully usable |
| `AI-ABSTAIN` | states what is missing and the action that would fix it; **never a null or zero score** |
| `AI-LOW` | delivered collapsed with an amber band; acceptance blocked until expanded |

**Responsive.** ≥1440 4 columns · 1024–1439 2 columns · <768 1 column, priority order

**Keyboard.** `Enter` drills into the focused tile · `r` refreshes.

**Accessibility.** Every `◆` region is `role="region"` with the confidence band in its accessible name — never colour alone. · Clinical status carries an icon **and** text (§5.3); abnormal reads `↑ High`, not a red cell. · Contrast ≥4.5:1 in both themes; touch targets ≥44px.

**Sample data.** `SD-F-01` — predicted no-show 14% Monday AM vs a flat 10% policy.

**Drawing notes.** ⚠️ State the ethics boundary on the screen: the score sets **overbooking and reminder intensity only**, never individual priority. · Show the wait-time consequence of overbooking — the trade-off must be visible to whoever sets it.

<!-- /M-05 -->

## M-06 · Outpatient Consultation & Clinical Documentation

**In one line.** The clinician's workspace — where the record is actually
written.

### M-06.1 Purpose & scope boundary

**Purpose.** The clinician portal. A consultant's worklist, the patient chart
summary, the consultation note with an ambient scribe, the problem list and
diagnosis coding, the clinical timeline, the prescription writer, patient
instructions, the co-sign and amendment queue, and personal template management.
This is the module that owns **clinical authoring** for outpatients.

**Does NOT cover.** Order placement is `M-09` (opened from here as an overlay).
Inpatient progress notes are `M-08`. Discharge summaries are `M-13`. Teleconsult
sessions are `M-27`, which reuses this module's note and prescription surfaces.
Results *review* is `M-09`.

**⚠️ The rule that governs every screen here.** A signed clinical entry is
**never edited** — only amended, with the amendment attributed and timestamped
(`CMP-NABH-10`). The `LOCKED` state and an `Addendum` action are therefore
mandatory on every authoring screen in this module, and `amend` is a distinct
capability from `write` (§3.2).

**What the client will judge this module on.** Whether a consultant finishes a
20-patient clinic without staying late to write notes. That is the single
strongest argument the product has for clinician adoption, and `S-06-03` plus
`S-06-04` are where it is made.

### M-06.2 Personas & permissions

| Persona | What they do here | Owns screens | Scope | Density | Device |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `P-04` Consultant | Author, sign, prescribe | `S-06-01`…`S-06-10` | `relationship`, `note.sign`, `rx.sign` | Compact | Tablet + desktop |
| `P-05` Resident | Author; **co-sign required** | `S-06-03`, `S-06-05` | `relationship`, `note.write` | Compact | Phone + ward desktop |
| `P-07` Staff Nurse | Reads note; delivers instructions | — | `unit` | Compact | WoW |
| `P-02` Administrator | Template governance only | `S-06-10` | `facility.admin` | Comfortable | Desktop |

⚠️ `P-05` holds `note.write` but not `note.sign` for the classes requiring a
consultant. Their entries land in `S-06-09` as `Co-sign pending`
(`CMP-NABH-03`).

| `AI-206` | Renal & hepatic dose adjustment | `S-06-07` | `AIP-02` | G2 | Mandatory | Printed reference is the fallback |

**⚠️ `S-06-07` is the deck's most important screen after the flagship** (§10.2
beat #8). It is where a penicillin-allergic patient (`SD-P-03`) is prescribed
co-amoxiclav, the AI suggestion is *blocked by a deterministic hard stop*, three
alternatives are offered, and an override requires a `G4` dual signature. It
converts "we have AI" from a risk into a reassurance.

**Module AI narrative.** *"Your consultant talks to the patient, and the note is
drafted as they speak — with the codes already attached. They read it, fix what
is wrong, and sign. And when the AI suggests something unsafe, the system stops
it — the hard rules are not negotiable by the model."*

#### W-06-1 · Outpatient consultation with ambient scribe

**Spine.** `S-06-01 → S-06-02 → S-06-03 → S-06-04 → S-06-03 → S-06-07 → S-06-01`
**Trigger.** `P-04` calls the next patient. Deck beats #5–#8.
**Terminal outcomes.** `O1` note signed + Rx issued · `O2` draft unsigned ·
`O3` signed, awaiting co-sign · `O4` signed, Rx blocked by a hard stop

| # | Actor | Screen | What happens | AI | Next |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `P-04` | `S-06-01` | U: opens My Day. S: list ranked by acuity, "needs attention" pinned with a reason chip | ◆AI-613 ◆AI-201 G0/G1 | 2 |

| 4! | `P-04` | `S-06-03` | **!** LOW confidence on a section. S: delivered **collapsed**, amber; ⚠️ Accept blocked until expanded | ◆AI-101 G2 | 4 |
| 5 | `P-04` | `S-06-05` | U: confirms the problem list. S: ICD-10 suggested per problem; parent-only codes blocked | ◆AI-501 ◆AI-204 G2 | 6 |
| 6 | `P-04` | `S-06-07` | U: prescribes. S: dose-range and interaction checks run **before** commit | ◆AI-305 ◆AI-205 ◆AI-206 G2 | 7? |

| 8 | `P-04` | `S-06-08` | U: issues instructions. S: rewritten in plain language, **bilingual print** | ◆AI-111 ◆AI-110 G2 | 9 |

| 9! | `P-04` | `S-06-03` | **!** Validation gaps. S: `VALIDATION` — "3 items need attention", inline errors, focus first, Sign stays disabled | ◆AI-114 G1 | 4 |

**Failure modes not shown as rows.** Scribe service down → `AI-OFF`: all `◆`
affordances **hidden, not greyed**, and steps 3–4 collapse to plain typing.
Offline → note queues locally, Sign offered as "will sign when reconnected".
Another user holds the note → `LOCKED` read-only naming who and when.

## M-07 · Emergency, Triage & Casualty

**In one line.** Acuity-first care for people who did not make an appointment.

### M-07.1 Purpose & scope boundary

**Purpose.** The ED tracking board, triage assessment, workup, time-critical
pathway activation, the resuscitation record, disposition, unidentified-patient
registration, police intimation and the MLC docket, and the inbound ambulance
tracker.

**Does NOT cover.** The stroke pathway's *specialist* surface is `M-18` — this
module **activates** it and hands over. Admission is `M-08`. ICU admission is
`M-12`. Registration mechanics are `M-04`.

**⚠️ This module reuses `M-18`'s machinery deliberately.** The clock,
activation, parallel-task-board and registry pattern built for stroke is applied
identically to STEMI (door-to-balloon), trauma and sepsis via `S-07-04`.
Demonstrating that the flagship is a **reusable pattern** rather than a one-off
is worth saying explicitly in the client meeting.

**What the client will judge this module on.** Whether the ED board tells the
truth — every patient, their acuity, their clock, and who owns the next action —
on a wall, without anyone updating it by hand.

### M-07.2 Personas & permissions

| Persona | What they do here | Owns screens | Scope | Density | Device |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `P-06` Emergency Physician | Workup, resus, disposition | `S-07-03`…`S-07-06`, `S-07-08` | `unit`, `note.sign` | **Compact** | Wall + workstation |
| `P-07` Staff Nurse | Triage, observations, tasks | `S-07-02`, `S-07-05` | `unit` | **Compact** | Bedside, gloved |
| `P-08` Nurse-in-Charge | Board ownership, flow | `S-07-01` | `unit` | Compact | Nursing station |
| `P-03` Front Office | Unidentified / MLC registration | `S-07-07` | `facility` | Compact | ED counter |
| `P-40` Dispatcher | Inbound tracking | `S-07-09` | `facility` | Compact | Control room |
| `P-24` MRD Officer | MLC docket completeness | — | `facility` | Compact | Desktop |

### M-07.5 AI capabilities in this module

| AI | Capability | Surfaces on | Pattern | Gate | Explain | Guardrail |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AI-614` | ED crowding & boarding forecast | `S-07-01` | `AIP-05`, `AIP-06` | G1 | Mandatory | Forecast only; never reprioritises a patient |
| `AI-208` | Early warning on vitals trend | `S-07-01` | `AIP-06` | G1 | Mandatory | Threshold alarms remain when off |
| `AI-207` | Triage acuity suggestion | `S-07-02` | `AIP-02` | **G2** | **Mandatory** | ⚠️ **The nurse assigns the level.** AI suggests; a downgrade always requires an explicit human action |
| `AI-209` | ⚠️ Time-critical pathway detection | `S-07-02`, `S-07-04` | `AIP-05` | G1 | Mandatory | ⚠️ **The manual activation button is always present and never gated on the model** |
| `AI-203` | Differential diagnosis suggestion | `S-07-03` | `AIP-03` | G1 | Mandatory | Suggests, never concludes |
| `AI-301` | Order suggestion from context | `S-07-03` | `AIP-03` | G2 | Mandatory | Accepting a suggestion never places an order — `S-09-01` signs it |
| `AI-210` | Resuscitation prompt & protocol timing | `S-07-05` | `AIP-05` | G1 | On demand | ⚠️ Printed algorithm + manual timer remain the fallback |
| `AI-615` | Disposition recommendation | `S-07-06` | `AIP-03` | G1 | Mandatory | Clinician decides; the recommendation is never a default |
| `AI-214` | Readmission risk | `S-07-06` | `AIP-06` | G1 | Mandatory | Informs follow-up intensity only |
| `AI-602` | Identity matching | `S-07-07` | `AIP-03` | G2 | Mandatory | ⚠️ **Identity uncertainty never delays care** — the encounter opens regardless |
| `AI-810` | Medico-legal documentation completeness | `S-07-08` | `AIP-05` | G1 | Mandatory | Flags gaps; never files on the user's behalf |
| `AI-616` | Ambulance ETA & inbound forecast | `S-07-09` | `AIP-06` | G1 | Mandatory | GPS position remains when off |

**⚠️ Two safety constraints specific to this module.** First, `AI-207` may
*raise* concern freely but a triage **downgrade** is always an explicit human
act with the AI's suggestion recorded — an under-triaged patient is the ED's
classic catastrophic failure. Second, `AI-602`'s identity work must never gate
treatment: `SD-P-08` arrives unidentified and the encounter opens immediately,
with identity resolved in parallel (`CMP-STAT-05`).

**Module AI narrative.** *"The board watches every patient's vitals trend and
tells your charge nurse who is deteriorating in the waiting room — the patient
nobody has looked at for forty minutes. And when the notes say 'left arm weak,
last normal 90 minutes ago', it puts a code-stroke prompt on the screen before
anyone has joined the dots."*

### M-07.9 Workflows

#### W-07-1 · Walk-in triage to disposition

**Spine.** `S-07-02 → S-07-01 → S-07-03 → S-07-06`
**Terminal outcomes.** `O1` discharged · `O2` admitted · `O3` ICU · `O4`
referred out · `O5` left without being seen

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `P-07` | `S-07-02` | U: triages. S: acuity suggested with reasoning | ◆AI-207 `AIP-02` **G2** | 2? |
| 2? | `P-07` | `S-07-02` | **?** Does the nurse agree with the suggested level | ◆AI-207 G2 | agrees → 3 · raises → 3 · **downgrades → 2!** |
| 2! | `P-07` | `S-07-02` | **!** ⚠️ A **downgrade** is an explicit human act; the AI's suggestion is retained on the record. Under-triage is the ED's classic catastrophic failure | ◆AI-207 G2 | 3 |
| 3 | — | `S-07-01` | S: patient appears on the board with a clock and an owner | ◆AI-614 ◆AI-208 G1 | 4 |
| 4 | `P-06` | `S-07-03` | U: works up. S: differentials suggested; orders proposed | ◆AI-203 ◆AI-301 G1/G2 | 5? |
| 5? | — | `S-07-01` | **?** Deteriorating while waiting | ◆AI-208 ◆AI-201 G1 | deteriorating → 5! · stable → 6 |
| 5! | `P-08` | `S-07-01` | **!** ⚠️ S: flags the patient **nobody has looked at for forty minutes**; charge nurse re-triages | ◆AI-208 `AIP-05` G1 | 4 |
| 6 | `P-06` | `S-07-06` | U: decides disposition. S: recommendation + readmission risk shown; ⚠️ never a default | ◆AI-615 ◆AI-214 G1 | 7 |
| 7 | — | `S-08-02`/`S-12-07` | S: handoff to admission or ICU request | ◆AI-611 G2 | terminal |

#### W-07-2 · Time-critical pathway activation (STEMI / sepsis / trauma)

**Spine.** `S-07-02 → S-07-04 → S-09-02`
**⚠️ Why it matters to the pitch.** This reuses `M-18`'s clock, activation,
task-board and registry machinery **identically** — proving the flagship is a

### M-07.10 Screen specifications

#### S-07-01 · ED Tracking Board

**One-liner.** Every patient in the department, their acuity and their clock.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Route** | `/ed/board` |
| **Archetype** | `ARC-04` board · density compact |
| **Persona** | `P-06` · `P-07` · `P-08` |
| **Permission** | `ed.board.read` @ `unit`. |
| **Entry** | Default landing for `P-06`/`P-08` · `GP-02` ▸ Emergency · wall display |
| **Exit** | Card → `S-07-03` · ▸ Triage → `S-07-02` · ▸ Disposition → `S-07-06` · ▸ Inbound → `S-07-09` |
| **In workflows** | `W-07-1` s3,5?,5! |
| **AI** | ◆AI-614 ◆AI-208 |
| **Tier / status** | T1 · ✅ |

**Zones.** `Z1` `Z2` — `GP-01`, `GP-02`, no deviation · `Z3` — n/a: not patient-scoped · `Z4` — scope selector (facility/ward), legend, `as of` timestamp · `Z5` — `C-21` columns by state, cards by entity · `Z7b` — `GP-17` assistant bubble, no deviation (§6.1)

**Table columns.** Card face: name or `⊘ identity pending` · age/sex · triage level (1–5) · elapsed since arrival · `◆AI-208` trend arrow · owner of next action · MLC flag. **No diagnosis on the card**

**Actions.**

| Action | Placement | Style | Enabled when | On activate | Confirm |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Open patient | card click | primary | `unit` | → `S-07-03` | none |
| Re-triage | card menu | primary | `P-07` | → `S-07-02`; ⚠️ a downgrade is always an explicit human act | none |
| Activate pathway | card menu | destructive-tinted | `P-06`/`P-07` | → `S-07-04` | none |
| Disposition | card menu | secondary | `P-06` | → `S-07-06` | none |

**AI touchpoints.**

| AI | Capability | Pattern | Gate | Explain | Guardrail |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AI-614` | ED crowding & boarding forecast | `AIP-05`, `AIP-06` | G1 | Mandatory | Forecast only; never reprioritises a patient |
| `AI-208` | Early warning on vitals & device trend | `AIP-06` | G1 | Mandatory | Threshold alarms remain when off |
| `AI-911` | Contextual assistant | `AIP-04` | G1 | ⚠️ Mandatory, cited | §6.1 — never clinical, grounded or silent |

**States.**

| Code | What to draw |
|---|---|
| `LOADING` | `C-45` skeleton matching the loaded geometry; `Z7a` disabled |
| `EMPTY` | explains why it is empty and the action that would change that |
| `PARTIAL` | ⚠️ a monitor feed down means the trend arrow shows `AI-ABSTAIN`, **never** a reassuring flat line |
| `ERROR` | recoverable, input preserved, retry plus an escape hatch |
| `VALIDATION` | problem count, inline errors, focus to the first, primary stays disabled |
| `DENIED` | `C-36` panel — what is missing, who grants it, request action. ⚠️ **no patient data on screen** |
| `BREAKGLASS` | `GP-10` amber banner, reason before content renders, "logged and reviewed" |
| `OFFLINE` | `C-37` strip — what works, what is queued, what is blocked; typed content never lost |
| `STALE` | board dims and states its last-good time — a confidently wrong ED board is dangerous |
| `SAVING` | primary disabled with a spinner; content not locked |
| `LOCKED` | read-only naming who holds it and since when, plus the legitimate next action |
| `AI-OFF` | every `◆` affordance **hidden, not greyed**; the `Z7b` bubble hidden; one quiet line; screen fully usable |
| `AI-ABSTAIN` | states what is missing and the action that would fix it; **never a null or zero score** |
| `AI-LOW` | delivered collapsed with an amber band; acceptance blocked until expanded |

**Responsive.** ≥1440 all columns · 1024–1439 horizontal scroll with sticky headers · <768 one column at a time with a column picker

**Keyboard.** `←`/`→` move between columns · `Enter` opens a card. Drag is never the only path to a state change.

**Accessibility.** Every `◆` region is `role="region"` with the confidence band in its accessible name — never colour alone. · Clinical status carries an icon **and** text (§5.3); abnormal reads `↑ High`, not a red cell. · Contrast ≥4.5:1 in both themes; touch targets ≥44px.

**Sample data.** `SD-F-01` ED at 08:40 — 14 patients, `SD-P-08` unidentified RTA in resus, one waiting 47 min with a rising NEWS2.

**Drawing notes.** ⚠️ Deck beat #10. Draw the **deteriorating patient in the waiting area** — the one nobody has looked at for 40 minutes. That is what the board is for. · ⚠️ Show `SD-P-08` as `⊘ identity pending` without blocking any clinical action. · Columns by care stage, cards by patient, clock on every card.

## M-08 · Inpatient ADT & Bed Management

**In one line.** Admission, the bed board, transfers, and who frees up today.

### M-08.1 Purpose & scope boundary

**Purpose.** Admission request and bed allocation, the ward bed board, the
inpatient worklist and progress note, transfers and bed changes, census and
occupancy, admission assessment, nursing handover, attendant and visitor
management, bed cleaning and turnaround, and the isolation and cohorting board.
It owns **bed state** across the group's 1,400 beds.

**Does NOT cover.** Bed *inventory* — that a bed exists — is `M-01` (§2.6).
Order placement is `M-09`; medication administration is `M-10`; the discharge
summary is `M-13`; bed **tariff** is `M-19`. Housekeeping *execution* is `M-22`;
this module owns the turnaround *state* a bed is in.

**⚠️ The three hard rules on bed allocation** — deterministic, never
AI-decided, and drawn as disabled targets with an inline reason
(§10.1 `ARC-04`): **gender mix** · **isolation category** (`CMP-NABH` infection
control) · **payer bed-class entitlement** (`CMP-PMJAY-03`). `AI-611` ranks
*within* the permitted set and may never rank around these. This is the second
screen in the deck where the AI is visibly governed.

**What the client will judge this module on.** Whether the bed board shows the
whole hospital at a glance and **predicts who frees up today** — because
discharge prediction is what converts a bed board from a status display into a
capacity tool.

### M-08.2 Personas & permissions

| Persona | What they do here | Owns screens | Scope | Density | Device |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `P-09` Bed Manager | Allocation, census, escalation | `S-08-01`, `S-08-02`, `S-08-06` | `facility`, `bed.allocate` | Comfortable | Desktop + wall |
| `P-07` Staff Nurse | Bed state, transfers, handover | `S-08-05`, `S-08-08` | `unit` | **Compact** | WoW + wall |
| `P-08` Nurse-in-Charge | Ward ownership, visitors, isolation | `S-08-09`, `S-08-11` | `unit` | Compact | Nursing station |
| `P-04` Consultant | Ward round, progress note, discharge decision | `S-08-03`, `S-08-04` | `relationship`, `note.sign` | Compact | Tablet |
| `P-05` Resident | Progress note (co-sign required) | — | `relationship`, `note.write` | Compact | Phone |
| `P-26` Infection Control Nurse | Isolation board | — | `facility` | Comfortable | Tablet |
| `P-29` Housekeeping Supervisor | Turnaround | `S-08-10` | `unit` | Comfortable | Phone |

**Module AI narrative.** *"At 07:00 the board already knows which fourteen
patients are likely to go home today, and why — so your bed manager is promising
beds she will actually have. And when she allocates one, the system has already
ruled out every bed that would break a gender-mix, isolation or PM-JAY
entitlement rule. It ranks the beds it is allowed to offer; it never argues with
the rules."*

### M-08.6 India & compliance overlay

| CMP | Obligation | UI consequence | Screens |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CMP-NABH-01` | Initial assessment within 24h | Countdown chip on the worklist row; overdue = ⚠️ | `S-08-03`, `S-08-07` |
| `CMP-NABH-02` | Nursing reassessment intervals | Due/overdue per patient per shift | `S-08-08` |
| `CMP-NABH-10` | ⚠️ Signed notes amended, never edited | `LOCKED` + `Addendum` | `S-08-04`, `S-08-07` |
| `CMP-NABH-11` | Author identity, reg. no., date/time | Attestation block, stamped on sign | `S-08-04` |
| `CMP-PMJAY-03` | ⚠️ Package rate fixes permitted bed class | Bed options above entitlement disabled **with a stated reason** | `S-08-02`, `S-08-05` |
| `CMP-TPA-05` | ⚠️ Room-rent proportionate deduction | Preview **before** the room class is chosen | `S-08-02` |
| `CMP-GST-02` | Room rent > ₹5,000/day is taxable | Reclassification on ward-class change, shown | `S-08-05` |
| `CMP-ABDM-02` | Care-context linking needs consent | `GP-09` chip in `Z3` on every screen | All |

### M-08.7 Integration touchpoints

| System | Dir | Standard | UI consequence |
|---|---|---|---|
| ADT → LIS / RIS / pharmacy | **→** | HL7 v2 `ADT^A01/A02/A03` | Invisible when healthy; failure is a ⚠️ in `GP-10` |
| Vitals monitors | **←** | HL7 v2 ORU / device gateway | Vitals tiles show value, unit, time and `source` chip |
| ABDM HIU | **↔** | FHIR R4 Bundle | Async with a stated cap, then `STALE` |
| `M-01` bed inventory | **←** | Internal | A bed must exist before it can hold a patient |
| `M-22` housekeeping | **↔** | Internal | Turnaround state round-trips |
| Nurse-call system | **←** | Vendor webhook | ⊘ Phase 2 — **draw the affordance, grey it** |

**Zones.** `Z1` `Z2` — `GP-01`, `GP-02`, no deviation · `Z3` — n/a: the board is ward-scoped, not patient-scoped. Patient identity appears **on the card** · `Z4` — facility + ward scope, legend, `as of` timestamp, occupancy % · `Z5` — `C-21` columns = bed state (Occupied · Ready · Cleaning · Blocked), cards = beds · `Z7b` — `GP-17` assistant bubble, no deviation (§6.1)

**Table columns.** Card face carries: bed id · patient name · age/sex · consultant · LOS · payer chip · ⚠️ allergy flag · MLC flag · isolation chip · `◆AI-610` discharge-today badge. **No diagnosis on the card** — a bed board is visible to a corridor.

**Actions.**

| Action | Placement | Style | Enabled when | On activate | Confirm |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Admit to ward | `Z7a` left | primary | `bed.allocate` held and ≥1 Ready bed exists | → `S-08-02` with the ward pre-bound | none |
| Round | card menu | secondary | `relationship` on that encounter | → `S-08-04` | none |
| Transfer | card menu | secondary | `bed.transfer` held | opens `S-08-05` as a `Z8` modal | none |
| Mark for cleaning | card menu | tertiary | bed state = Occupied and patient discharged | → `S-08-10`, bed state → Cleaning | none |
| Block bed | card menu | destructive-tinted | `bed.admin` held | reason mandatory from a fixed list | ⚠️ modal naming the downstream capacity effect |
| Print census | `Z7a` | tertiary | always | `GP-15` — ⚠️ class-3 audit event | none |

**AI touchpoints.**

| AI | Capability | Pattern | Gate | Explain | Guardrail |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AI-610` | Discharge-today prediction | `AIP-06` | G1 | Mandatory | ⚠️ Never blocks or forces a bed action; advisory only |
| `AI-611` | ⚠️ Bed allocation optimisation | `AIP-03`, `AIP-07` | **G2** | **Mandatory** | ⚠️ **Gender mix, isolation and payer entitlement are hard and deterministic.** Ranking happens only within the permitted set |
| `AI-807` | ⚠️ Isolation & cohorting recommendation | `AIP-03` | **G2** | Mandatory | ⚠️ Isolation category rules are deterministic and always enforced |
| `AI-911` | Contextual assistant | `AIP-04` | G1 | ⚠️ Mandatory, cited | §6.1 — never clinical, grounded or silent |

**States.**

| Code | What to draw |
|---|---|
| `LOADING` | `C-45` skeleton matching the loaded geometry; `Z7a` disabled |
| `EMPTY` | ⚠️ never legitimately empty for a live ward — an empty board means a data fault, so it renders as `ERROR`, not `EMPTY` |
| `PARTIAL` | ⚠️ the common case. One ward's feed is down: that column shows "Ward 2A unavailable since 08:12", the count is qualified "(26 of 29 wards)", the rest stays live |
| `ERROR` | recoverable, input preserved, retry plus an escape hatch |
| `VALIDATION` | problem count, inline errors, focus to the first, primary stays disabled |
| `DENIED` | `C-36` panel — what is missing, who grants it, request action. ⚠️ **no patient data on screen** |
| `BREAKGLASS` | `GP-10` amber banner, reason before content renders, "logged and reviewed" |
| `OFFLINE` | `C-37` strip — what works, what is queued, what is blocked; typed content never lost |
| `STALE` | board dims 10%, `as of` turns amber past 2× the refresh interval. ⚠️ A bed board showing confidently wrong data is worse than one showing none |
| `SAVING` | primary disabled with a spinner; content not locked |
| `LOCKED` | a card being edited elsewhere shows "Sr. Raman is moving this patient" and its actions disable, without locking the board |
| `AI-OFF` | `◆AI-610` badges and `◆AI-611` ranking hidden entirely; beds fall to ward-then-bed-number order; `Z7b` hidden. **Board fully usable** |
| `AI-ABSTAIN` | states what is missing and the action that would fix it; **never a null or zero score** |
| `AI-LOW` | delivered collapsed with an amber band; acceptance blocked until expanded |

**Responsive.** ≥1440 all four columns · 1024–1439 horizontal scroll, sticky column headers, card face drops LOS · <768 ⚠️ one column with a picker, card face reduces to bed id + name + the discharge badge

**Keyboard.** `←`/`→` move between columns · `Enter` opens a card. Drag is never the only path to a state change.

**Accessibility.** Bed state is carried by the **column, a shape and a label** — never colour alone. · ⚠️ The allergy flag is text `PENICILLIN`, not an icon alone, and is in the card's accessible name. · Auto-refresh announces via `aria-live="polite"` and must not move keyboard focus. · Every `◆` region is `role="region"` with the confidence band in its accessible name — never colour alone. · Clinical status carries an icon **and** text (§5.3); abnormal reads `↑ High`, not a red cell. · Contrast ≥4.5:1 in both themes; touch targets ≥44px.

**Sample data.** Facility `SD-F-01`, ward 4B. Beds `4B-12` (`SD-P-03`, discharge-today HIGH), `4B-13` (`SD-P-04`, contact isolation), `4B-07`/`4B-14` ready, `4B-19` cleaning, `4B-22` blocked terminal-clean.

**Drawing notes.** Draw the **`PARTIAL`** state as the second frame — it is the honest one and it is the state a buyer has been burned by. · `◆AI-610` on `4B-12` with `85%` and a `Why? >` link is the single most valuable pixel on this screen. · Show `4B-22` blocked for isolation so the viewer sees a bed the AI is **not allowed** to offer. · Do not put a diagnosis on any card.

**Open questions.** `OQ-513` — is a 55-inch wall actually being bought, or is this desktop-and-phone only?

## M-09 · Orders, CPOE & Results Review

**In one line.** One order pipeline for every orderable thing, and the loop
closed on results.

### M-09.1 Purpose & scope boundary

**Purpose.** The single order pipeline — labs, imaging, drugs, procedures, diet,
nursing, referrals — with order sets and pathways, active-order status, the
results inbox, result detail and trends, critical-result acknowledgement, verbal
order capture, and diagnostic stewardship.

**Does NOT cover.** *Fulfilment* belongs to the performing module: `M-14` lab,
`M-15` radiology, `M-16` pharmacy, `M-17` blood bank and dialysis, `M-22`
dietary. This module owns the order's **lifecycle**, not its execution.
Prescription *authoring* for outpatients is `M-06`.

**⚠️ `DD-006`, the distinction that prevents the largest single source of
revenue leakage.** An **orderable** (what a clinician asks for), a
**performable** (what a department does) and a **billable** (what appears on an
invoice) are three different things with a mapping between them. A screen that
conflates them produces orders that cannot be performed or performed work that is
never billed.

**What the client will judge this module on.** Whether a critical lab result
reaches a named human and is **acknowledged**, with an escalation path when it is
not. Closed-loop results are a NABH obligation and a medico-legal exposure.

### M-09.2 Personas & permissions

| Persona | What they do here | Owns screens | Scope | Density | Device |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `P-04` Consultant | Order, sign, review, acknowledge | `S-09-01`…`S-09-06` | `relationship`, `order.sign` | Compact | Tablet + desktop |
| `P-05` Resident | Order (co-sign per class), review | — | `relationship`, `order.write` | Compact | Phone |
| `P-07` Staff Nurse | Verbal orders, status, acknowledge | `S-09-07` | `unit` | **Compact** | WoW |
| `P-25` Quality Manager | Stewardship review | `S-09-08` | `facility` | Comfortable | Desktop |

| `S-09-02` order set ▸ Apply | Click | `S-09-01` prefilled | — |
| `NTF-01` critical result | ⚠️ Interrupt | `S-09-06` modal | `S-09-05` |
| Shift start | Default for `P-04` | `S-09-04` | `S-09-05` |
