| `AI-303` | Pathway adherence monitoring | `S-09-02` | `AIP-05` | G1 | Mandatory | Manual checklist remains |
| `AI-308` | Order status & closed-loop chasing | `S-09-03` | `AIP-07` | G1 | On demand | Plain status list remains |
| `AI-212` | Result interpretation & delta check | `S-09-04`, `S-09-05` | `AIP-06`, `AIP-02` | G1 | Mandatory | Reference ranges and prior values always shown |
| `AI-213` | ⚠️ Critical-value detection & escalation | `S-09-04`, `S-09-06` | `AIP-09`, `AIP-05` | **G2** | **Mandatory** | ⚠️ **Rule-based thresholds remain when the model is off.** Escalation is never model-dependent |
| `AI-109` | Lab report narrative draft | `S-09-05` | `AIP-01` | G3 | Mandatory | Numeric results with ranges remain |
| `AI-309` | Verbal order transcription | `S-09-07` | `AIP-01` | G2 | Mandatory | ⚠️ Handwrite-then-key remains; read-back is still required |

**⚠️ `S-09-06` is the screen a lawyer will ask about.** A critical value must
reach a **named human** who **acknowledges** it, with an escalation chain when
they do not, and a durable record of both. The AI ranks and detects; the
threshold-based floor and the escalation chain are deterministic and survive an
`AI-OFF` state entirely.

**Module AI narrative.** *"Results arrive ranked by how much they should worry
you, with a one-line reason. The critical ones do not sit in an inbox — they
interrupt a named person, and if nobody acknowledges in the window, they
escalate. And when someone orders the same CT twice in six hours, the system
says so before the patient is irradiated again."*

### M-09.6 India & compliance overlay

| CMP | Obligation | UI consequence | Screens |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CMP-NABH-05` | Legible, complete orders; no banned abbreviations | `AI-114`; abbreviations rejected | `S-09-01` |
| `CMP-NABH-06` | High-risk medication double-check | `G4` on the designated list | `S-09-01` |
| `CMP-DIAG-05` | ⚠️ HIV Act — consent before test, restricted visibility | Consent gate at ordering; result class restricted | `S-09-01`, `S-09-05` |
| `CMP-DIAG-01` | ⚠️ PCPNDT — obstetric ultrasound | Order carries the Form F obligation forward to `S-15-07` | `S-09-01` |
| `CMP-DRUG-06` | Teleconsult prescribing categories | Gate applied when the encounter is a teleconsult | `S-09-01` |
| `CMP-ABDM-03` | DiagnosticReport published | Per-record publish status on release | `S-09-05` |

### M-09.10 Screen specifications

#### S-09-01 · Order Entry / Basket

**One-liner.** One basket for everything a clinician can order.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Route** | `/encounter/{id}/orders/new` |
| **Archetype** | `ARC-07` basket · density compact |
| **Persona** | `P-04` · `P-05` |
| **Permission** | `orders.write` + `relationship`; `orders.sign` to commit. ⚠️ Controlled classes need a consultant. |
| **Entry** | `S-06-03` / `S-08-04` ▸ Order · `S-09-02` ▸ Apply set · `S-07-03` ▸ Order |
| **Exit** | Sign → `S-09-03` and the performing module · Cancel → the calling note |
| **In workflows** | `W-08-2` s6,6! · `W-09-1` s1,2?,2!,3,4?,4! · `W-09-3` s2 · `W-17-1` s1 |
| **AI** | ◆AI-301 ◆AI-302 ◆AI-304 ◆AI-205 |
| **Tier / status** | T2 · ✅ |

**Zones.** `Z1` `Z2` — `GP-01`, `GP-02`, no deviation · `Z3` — `GP-05` patient banner, no deviation · `Z4` — search / catalogue entry · `Z5a` — `C-08` search and catalogue · `Z5b` — the basket · `Z6` — `C-43` suggestions · `Z7a` — sign / submit bar · `Z7b` — `GP-17` assistant bubble, no deviation (§6.1)

**Fields.**

| # | Label | Type | Req | Validation / format | Default / source | AI |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Search orderable | `typeahead` | ✅ | service master (`S-03-03`); ⚠️ only orderables enabled at this facility | — | ◆AI-301 G2 |
| 2 | Priority | `radio` | ✅ | routine / urgent / stat | — | — |
| 3 | Clinical indication | `typeahead` | 🟡 | ⚠️ mandatory for high-cost and controlled items | problem list | ◆AI-204 G1 |
| 4 | Specimen / site | `select` | 🟡 | where applicable | — | — |
| 5 | Start & duration | `datetime` | ✅ | — | — | — |
| 6 | Attestation | `signature` | ✅ | ⚠️ stamps identity, reg. no., time on sign | session user | — |

**Actions.**

| Action | Placement | Style | Enabled when | On activate | Confirm |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Add to basket | `Z5a` | primary | `orders.write` | ⚠️ accepting an AI suggestion puts it in the **basket**, never in the order queue | none |
| Apply order set | `Z4` | secondary | `orders.write` | → `S-09-02`; adds the set as editable basket lines | none |
| Sign basket | `Z7a` right | primary | ⚠️ no hard stop outstanding · every `G2` dispositioned | commits; dispatches to LIS/RIS/pharmacy | none |
| Override hard stop | `Z8` gate | destructive | ⚠️ `G4` — reason **and** a second consultant | emits `AI.SAF.HARD_STOP_OVERRIDDEN` | ⚠️ dual-signature modal |
| Proceed past duplicate | inline | secondary | `AI-304` flagged | ⚠️ advisory — proceeds **with a reason** | none |

**AI touchpoints.**

| AI | Capability | Pattern | Gate | Explain | Guardrail |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AI-301` | Order suggestion from clinical context | `AIP-03` | G2 | Mandatory | ⚠️ Acceptance places it in the **basket**, never the order queue |
| `AI-302` | Order-set & pathway recommendation | `AIP-03` | G2 | Mandatory | Browsable library remains |
| `AI-304` | Duplicate & low-value test detection | `AIP-05` | G2 | Mandatory | ⚠️ Advises; a clinician may always proceed with a reason |
| `AI-205` | ⚠️ Drug interaction, allergy & contraindication check | `AIP-09` | **G2/G4** | **Mandatory** | ⚠️ Deterministic hard stop; `G4` override with a second consultant |
| `AI-911` | Contextual assistant | `AIP-04` | G1 | ⚠️ Mandatory, cited | §6.1 — never clinical, grounded or silent |

**States.**

| Code | What to draw |
|---|---|
| `LOADING` | `C-45` skeleton matching the loaded geometry; `Z7a` disabled |
| `EMPTY` | explains why it is empty and the action that would change that |
| `PARTIAL` | the failed region names what is missing and since when; the rest stays usable |
| `ERROR` | recoverable, input preserved, retry plus an escape hatch |
| `VALIDATION` | problem count, inline errors, focus to the first, primary stays disabled |
| `DENIED` | `C-36` panel — what is missing, who grants it, request action. ⚠️ **no patient data on screen** |
| `BREAKGLASS` | `GP-10` amber banner, reason before content renders, "logged and reviewed" |
| `OFFLINE` | `C-37` strip — what works, what is queued, what is blocked; typed content never lost |
| `STALE` | timestamp turns amber, "Data as of HH:MM · Refresh" |
| `SAVING` | primary disabled with a spinner; content not locked |
| `LOCKED` | read-only naming who holds it and since when, plus the legitimate next action |
| `AI-OFF` | every `◆` affordance **hidden, not greyed**; the `Z7b` bubble hidden; one quiet line; screen fully usable |
| `AI-ABSTAIN` | states what is missing and the action that would fix it; **never a null or zero score** |
| `AI-LOW` | delivered collapsed with an amber band; acceptance blocked until expanded |

**Responsive.** ≥1280 two-pane · 1024–1279 basket becomes a `Z8` drawer with a count badge · <768 sequential: search, then basket

**Keyboard.** `/` focuses search · `Enter` adds to basket · basket is never submitted by `Enter`.

**Accessibility.** Every `◆` region is `role="region"` with the confidence band in its accessible name — never colour alone. · Clinical status carries an icon **and** text (§5.3); abnormal reads `↑ High`, not a red cell. · Contrast ≥4.5:1 in both themes; touch targets ≥44px.

**Sample data.** `SD-P-03` — serum Mg and chest X-ray from suggestions; a duplicate CT within 6h flagged; a penicillin hard stop on one line.

**Drawing notes.** ⚠️ Draw the distinction plainly: `◆AI-301` suggestions live in `Z6` and land in the **basket**; only `Sign` places orders. · Draw the duplicate-test advisory next to the allergy hard stop so the difference between advisory and deterministic is visible in one frame.

## M-10 · Nursing Care, eMAR & Vitals

**In one line.** The eight hours between ward rounds, which is where most care
happens.

### M-10.1 Purpose & scope boundary

**Purpose.** The nursing task board, vitals capture, the electronic medication
administration record with barcode verification, intake/output and fluid
balance, nursing assessment and care plan, risk assessments (fall, pressure
area, VTE), nursing notes, and ward stock indent.

**Does NOT cover.** Medication *ordering* is `M-09`; *dispensing* is `M-16`.
Bed state is `M-08`. ICU high-frequency charting is `M-12`, which uses a
different cadence and its own flowsheet.

**⚠️ The five-rights rule is the module's spine.** Right patient, right drug,
right dose, right route, right time — verified by scan at the bedside
(`S-10-04`), with a **keyed fallback that is never removed** because scanners
fail and labels smudge (`GP-14`). A barcode mismatch is an `AIP-09` modal gate,
not a warning toast.

**What the client will judge this module on.** Whether a nurse can complete a
medication round on a gloved hand at a bedside without a keyboard, and whether
the eMAR catches a wrong-patient administration before it happens.

### M-10.2 Personas & permissions

| Persona | What they do here | Owns screens | Scope | Density | Device |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `P-07` Staff Nurse | Everything at the bedside | `S-10-02`…`S-10-08` | `unit`, `med.administer` | **Compact** | WoW, phone, gloved |
| `P-08` Nurse-in-Charge | Task allocation, ward stock | `S-10-01`, `S-10-09` | `unit` | Compact | Nursing station |
| `P-04` Consultant | Reads eMAR, vitals, care plan | — | `relationship` | Compact | Tablet |
| `P-14` Pharmacist | Reads administration record | — | `facility` | Compact | Counter |

|---|---|---|---|

| `S-08-08` handover ▸ Start shift | Click | `S-10-01` | — |
| Wristband scan (`GP-14`) | Scan | `S-10-03` for that patient | — |
| `S-10-01` task ▸ Administer | Click | `S-10-03` → `S-10-04` | Back to `S-10-01` |
| `S-10-01` task ▸ Vitals | Click | `S-10-02` | Back |
| `AI-201` risk high | `AIP-05` | `S-10-02` | `S-12-07` if escalated |
| `NTF-14` med due | Push | `S-10-03` | — |

**Module AI narrative.** *"The task board puts the overdue antibiotic and the
deteriorating patient at the top, with a reason next to each. At the bedside the
nurse scans the wristband and the drug, and the system checks the five rights
before she gives it — and if the model is down, the barcode check and the dose
tables still work."*

### M-10.9 Workflows

**Spine.** `S-10-01 → S-10-03 → S-10-04 → S-10-03`

### M-10.10 Screen specifications

#### S-10-01 · Nursing Worklist / Task Board

**One-liner.** The nurse's shift, ordered by what actually matters next.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Route** | `/nursing/tasks` |
| **Archetype** | `ARC-01` worklist · density compact |
| **Persona** | `P-07` · `P-08` |
| **Permission** | `nursing.task.read` @ `unit`. |
| **Entry** | Default landing for `P-07` at shift start · `S-08-08` handover accepted · `NTF-14` med due |
| **Exit** | Task → the owning screen · ▸ Vitals → `S-10-02` · ▸ eMAR → `S-10-03` |
| **In workflows** | `W-08-4` s4 · `W-10-1` s1 · `W-10-3` s4! |
| **AI** | ◆AI-619 |
| **Tier / status** | T2 · ✅ |

**Zones.** `Z1` `Z2` — `GP-01`, `GP-02`, no deviation · `Z3` — n/a: not patient-scoped · `Z4` — title, filter chips, sort control, row count · `Z5` — `C-19` data table, sticky header, `C-20` rows · `Z6` — optional preview of the selected row · `Z7b` — `GP-17` assistant bubble, no deviation (§6.1)

**Table columns.** Time due · patient · bed · task · type · `◆AI-619` rank reason · overdue by · `◆AI-201` patient risk

**Actions.**

| Action | Placement | Style | Enabled when | On activate | Confirm |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Open task | row click | primary | `unit` | → the owning screen with the patient bound | none |
| Complete inline | row | primary | single-step task | records with identity and time | none |
| Sort by due time | `Z4` | secondary | always | ⚠️ the deterministic order, one click away | none |
| Defer with reason | row menu | secondary | `unit` | ⚠️ reason mandatory; an overdue task is never silently hidden | inline dialog |

**AI touchpoints.**

| AI | Capability | Pattern | Gate | Explain | Guardrail |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AI-619` | Task prioritisation & workload balancing | `AIP-07` | G1 | Mandatory | ⚠️ Due-time order always one click away; never hides an overdue task |
| `AI-911` | Contextual assistant | `AIP-04` | G1 | ⚠️ Mandatory, cited | §6.1 — never clinical, grounded or silent |

**States.**

| Code | What to draw |
|---|---|
| `LOADING` | `C-45` skeleton matching the loaded geometry; `Z7a` disabled |
| `EMPTY` | explains why it is empty and the action that would change that |
| `PARTIAL` | the failed region names what is missing and since when; the rest stays usable |
| `ERROR` | recoverable, input preserved, retry plus an escape hatch |
| `VALIDATION` | problem count, inline errors, focus to the first, primary stays disabled |
| `DENIED` | `C-36` panel — what is missing, who grants it, request action. ⚠️ **no patient data on screen** |
| `BREAKGLASS` | `GP-10` amber banner, reason before content renders, "logged and reviewed" |
| `OFFLINE` | `C-37` strip — what works, what is queued, what is blocked; typed content never lost |
| `STALE` | timestamp turns amber, "Data as of HH:MM · Refresh" |
| `SAVING` | primary disabled with a spinner; content not locked |
| `LOCKED` | read-only naming who holds it and since when, plus the legitimate next action |
| `AI-OFF` | every `◆` affordance **hidden, not greyed**; the `Z7b` bubble hidden; one quiet line; screen fully usable |
| `AI-ABSTAIN` | states what is missing and the action that would fix it; **never a null or zero score** |
| `AI-LOW` | delivered collapsed with an amber band; acceptance blocked until expanded |

**Responsive.** ≥1280 table + preview rail · 1024–1279 preview becomes a `Z8` drawer · <768 rows become stacked cards, 2 lines each

**Keyboard.** `↑`/`↓` move selection · `Enter` opens · `Space` previews · `/` focuses filter. Selection survives a background refresh.

**Accessibility.** Every `◆` region is `role="region"` with the confidence band in its accessible name — never colour alone. · Clinical status carries an icon **and** text (§5.3); abnormal reads `↑ High`, not a red cell. · Contrast ≥4.5:1 in both themes; touch targets ≥44px.

**Sample data.** `SD-S-05` on ward 4B — 23 tasks, an overdue antibiotic pinned, `SD-P-03` deteriorating, 2 reassessments due.

**Drawing notes.** ⚠️ Draw the top of the list with **reason chips**: "overdue 20 min", "NEWS2 rising". Ranking without reasons is not trusted at a bedside. · Phone and workstation-on-wheels frames both matter here.

## M-11 · Operation Theatre, Anaesthesia & Day Care

**In one line.** The most expensive hour in the hospital, scheduled and
accounted for.

### M-11.1 Purpose & scope boundary

**Purpose.** The OT schedule board, surgery booking, pre-anaesthetic assessment,
the WHO surgical safety checklist, the intra-operative record, the anaesthesia
chart, implant and consumable traceability, post-anaesthesia recovery, the
operation note, and day-care/endoscopy flow.

**Does NOT cover.** Surgeon rostering is `M-23`. Instrument sterilisation is
`M-22` (CSSD). Implant *stock* is `M-21`; this module records which implant went
into which patient. Bed allocation for the post-op ward is `M-08`.

**⚠️ Two hard gates.** The WHO checklist (`CMP-NABH-07`) — **the OT record
cannot close without it**. And informed consent (`CMP-NABH-08`) — which blocks
scheduling *confirmation*, not the booking itself, so a case can be provisionally
listed while consent is obtained.

**What the client will judge this module on.** OT utilisation. A board that
predicts case duration from the surgeon's own history rather than the booked
slot is the difference between six cases a day and eight.

### M-11.2 Personas & permissions

| Persona | What they do here | Owns screens | Scope | Density | Device |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `P-17` OT Coordinator / Scrub Nurse | Board, checklist, intra-op, implants | `S-11-01`, `S-11-04`, `S-11-05`, `S-11-07` | `unit` | Compact | OT wall + workstation |
| `P-16` Anaesthetist | PAC, anaesthesia chart, PACU | `S-11-03`, `S-11-06`, `S-11-08` | `relationship` | Compact | OT workstation, gloved |
| `P-04` Consultant Surgeon | Booking, operation note | `S-11-02`, `S-11-09` | `relationship`, `note.sign` | Compact | Tablet |
| `P-07` Staff Nurse | Day care, recovery observations | `S-11-10` | `unit` | Compact | Bedside |
| `P-27` Materials Manager | Implant traceability | — | `facility` | Compact | Store |

|---|---|---|---|

| `S-06-03` ▸ Book surgery | Click | `S-11-02` | `S-08-02` for the bed |

### M-11.5 AI capabilities in this module

**Module AI narrative.** *"The board learns that this surgeon's laparoscopic
cholecystectomy actually takes 68 minutes, not the 45 he books — so the list
stops overrunning at 16:00 every day. And the operation note is drafted from the
intra-op record, so it is signed before he leaves the theatre instead of three
days later."*

### M-11.6 India & compliance overlay

| CMP | Obligation | UI consequence | Screens |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CMP-NABH-07` | ⚠️ WHO checklist for every procedure | **The OT record cannot close without it** | `S-11-04` |
| `CMP-NABH-08` | Informed consent before the procedure | Blocks scheduling **confirmation**; booking may proceed | `S-11-02`, `S-11-04` |
| `CMP-NABH-11` | Author identity and reg. no. on the op note | Attestation block | `S-11-09` |
| `CMP-PMJAY-02` | HBP package incl. implant add-ons | Implant selection drives the package variance | `S-11-02`, `S-11-07` |
| `CMP-TPA-02` | Enhancement when the estimate is exceeded | Triggered by intra-op implant or duration variance | `S-11-07` |
| `CMP-STAT-06` | Fire, electrical and gas statutory clearances for theatres | Licence state visible on the board when lapsed | `S-11-01` |

|---|---|---|---|
| Anaesthesia machines & monitors | **←** | Device gateway | Auto-charting with `source` chip |

### M-11.9 Workflows

#### W-11-1 · Elective surgery from booking to operation note

**Spine.** `S-11-02 → S-11-03 → S-11-01 → S-11-04 → S-11-05 → S-11-08 → S-11-09`
**Terminal outcomes.** `O1` completed + note signed · `O2` cancelled pre-op ·
`O3` postponed intra-op

#### S-11-01 · OT Schedule Board

**One-liner.** Tomorrow's theatre list, and whether it will actually fit.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Route** | `/ot/board` |
| **Archetype** | `ARC-04` board · density compact |
| **Persona** | `P-17` · `P-16` · `P-04` |
| **Permission** | `ot.board.read` @ `unit`. |
| **Entry** | `GP-02` ▸ Theatre · `S-11-02` after booking · `S-18-18` cath lab reservation |
| **Exit** | Case → `S-11-04` · ▸ Book → `S-11-02` · ▸ Day care → `S-11-10` |
| **In workflows** | `W-11-2` s1,2?,3,4 · `W-11-3` s2 · `W-18-1` s18 · `W-22-2` s3 |
| **AI** | ◆AI-617 |
| **Tier / status** | T2 · ✅ |

**Zones.** `Z1` `Z2` — `GP-01`, `GP-02`, no deviation · `Z3` — n/a: not patient-scoped · `Z4` — scope selector (facility/ward), legend, `as of` timestamp · `Z5` — `C-21` columns by state, cards by entity · `Z7b` — `GP-17` assistant bubble, no deviation (§6.1)

**Table columns.** Theatre lane × time · patient · procedure · surgeon · anaesthetist · booked vs `◆AI-617` predicted · checklist state · implant flag

**Actions.**

| Action | Placement | Style | Enabled when | On activate | Confirm |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Open case | card click | primary | `unit` | → `S-11-04` checklist | none |
| Reorder list | card drag | primary | `P-17` | ⚠️ infection-control sequencing (clean before contaminated) is a **hard rule** the optimiser works within | ⚠️ modal if sequencing would break |
| Accept optimisation | `Z4` | secondary | `AI-617` proposed an order | shows predicted vs booked duration per case | none |
| Mark theatre unavailable | `Z4` | destructive-tinted | `P-17` | ⚠️ names affected cases and requires a disposition for each | ⚠️ modal |

**AI touchpoints.**

| AI | Capability | Pattern | Gate | Explain | Guardrail |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AI-617` | OT & resource schedule optimisation, case-duration prediction | `AIP-03`, `AIP-06` | G2 | Mandatory | ⚠️ The surgeon's booked duration always wins; the prediction is shown beside it |
| `AI-911` | Contextual assistant | `AIP-04` | G1 | ⚠️ Mandatory, cited | §6.1 — never clinical, grounded or silent |

**States.**

| Code | What to draw |
|---|---|
| `LOADING` | `C-45` skeleton matching the loaded geometry; `Z7a` disabled |
| `EMPTY` | explains why it is empty and the action that would change that |
| `PARTIAL` | the failed region names what is missing and since when; the rest stays usable |
| `ERROR` | recoverable, input preserved, retry plus an escape hatch |
| `VALIDATION` | problem count, inline errors, focus to the first, primary stays disabled |
| `DENIED` | `C-36` panel — what is missing, who grants it, request action. ⚠️ **no patient data on screen** |
| `BREAKGLASS` | `GP-10` amber banner, reason before content renders, "logged and reviewed" |
| `OFFLINE` | `C-37` strip — what works, what is queued, what is blocked; typed content never lost |
| `STALE` | timestamp turns amber, "Data as of HH:MM · Refresh" |
| `SAVING` | primary disabled with a spinner; content not locked |
| `LOCKED` | read-only naming who holds it and since when, plus the legitimate next action |
| `AI-OFF` | every `◆` affordance **hidden, not greyed**; the `Z7b` bubble hidden; one quiet line; screen fully usable |
| `AI-ABSTAIN` | states what is missing and the action that would fix it; **never a null or zero score** |
| `AI-LOW` | delivered collapsed with an amber band; acceptance blocked until expanded |

**Responsive.** ≥1440 all columns · 1024–1439 horizontal scroll with sticky headers · <768 one column at a time with a column picker

**Keyboard.** `←`/`→` move between columns · `Enter` opens a card. Drag is never the only path to a state change.

**Accessibility.** Every `◆` region is `role="region"` with the confidence band in its accessible name — never colour alone. · Clinical status carries an icon **and** text (§5.3); abnormal reads `↑ High`, not a red cell. · Contrast ≥4.5:1 in both themes; touch targets ≥44px.

**Sample data.** `OT-1`…`OT-6` at `SD-F-01`; `SD-P-02` CABG; one lap chole booked 45 min against a 68-min prediction.

**Drawing notes.** ⚠️ Draw **predicted vs booked duration** side by side with a projected overrun at 16:00 — that gap is the whole utilisation argument. · Show the infection-control sequencing constraint as a hard rule, not a suggestion. · Include the cath lab lane so `S-18-18`'s reservation is visible here.

## M-12 · Critical Care & ICU

**In one line.** High-frequency charting, scores, and deterioration caught
early.

### M-12.1 Purpose & scope boundary

**Purpose.** The ICU unit dashboard, the high-frequency ICU flowsheet,
ventilator and device data, severity scores and trends, the sepsis and
deterioration watch list, daily goals and the rounding checklist, and ICU bed
request and triage.

**Does NOT cover.** General ward charting is `M-10` — the cadence and the
flowsheet are genuinely different. Bed *allocation* is `M-08`; this module owns
the ICU bed **request** and its clinical triage. Tele-ICU is `M-27`.

**What the client will judge this module on.** Whether the unit dashboard shows
deterioration before the round, and whether severity scores are computed rather
than hand-entered — because hand-entered APACHE scores are always stale.

### M-12.2 Personas & permissions

| Persona | What they do here | Owns screens | Scope | Density | Device |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `P-18` Intensivist | All clinical | `S-12-01`…`S-12-07` | `relationship`, `note.sign` | Compact | ICU workstation + wall |
| `P-07` Staff Nurse | Flowsheet, observations | `S-12-02` | `unit` | **Compact** | Bedside, gloved |
| `P-08` Nurse-in-Charge | Unit overview | — | `unit` | Compact | Wall |
| `P-09` Bed Manager | ICU bed requests | — | `facility` | Comfortable | Desktop |

### M-12.3 Entry points & exits

| Arrive from | Trigger | Lands on | Leaves to |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GP-02` nav rail ▸ Critical care | Click | `S-12-01` | — |
| `S-07-06` disposition = ICU | Handoff | `S-12-07` | Back on refusal |
| `S-08-04` ▸ Escalate | Click | `S-12-07` | — |
| `S-12-01` bed ▸ Open | Click | `S-12-02` | `S-12-04` |
| `AI-202` sepsis alert | `AIP-05` | `S-12-05` | `S-09-01` for the bundle |
| `NTF-02` deterioration | ⚠️ Interrupt | `S-12-05` | — |

| `AI-303` | Pathway & protocol adherence | `S-12-06` | `AIP-05` | G1 | Mandatory | Manual checklist remains |
| `AI-611` | Bed allocation optimisation | `S-12-07` | `AIP-03` | G2 | Mandatory | ⚠️ Hard rules deterministic |

**⚠️ `AI-215`'s guardrail is an ethical boundary, stated on the screen.** A
mortality prediction may inform resource planning and family conversations. It
may **never** appear in, or be cited by, a treatment-limitation decision, and
`S-12-04` says so in the explainability drawer's Limits panel.

**Module AI narrative.** *"The unit board ranks your patients by who is
deteriorating, not by bed number — and it shows the three vitals that moved. The
sepsis watch fires on the pattern, not on a single threshold, and it opens the
one-hour bundle as a ready order set."*

### M-12.6 India & compliance overlay

| CMP | Obligation | UI consequence | Screens |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CMP-NABH-02` | Reassessment at defined intervals | ICU intervals are shorter; due/overdue per hour | `S-12-02` |
| `CMP-NABH-11` | Author identity on every entry | Stamped on save | `S-12-02`, `S-12-06` |
| `CMP-TPA-02` | Enhancement as ICU stay extends | Variance triggers a `M-20` enhancement | `S-12-01` |
| `CMP-PMJAY-03` | ICU bed class entitlement | Entitlement shown at request; never blocks clinical admission | `S-12-07` |
| `CMP-STAT-03` | Death registration and MCCD | Handoff to `S-13-06` | `S-12-01` |

### M-12.7 Integration touchpoints

| System | Dir | Standard | UI consequence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Multi-parameter monitors | **←** | HL7 v2 ORU / device gateway | High-frequency auto-charting with `source` chips |
| Ventilators | **←** | Device gateway | Settings and measured values; a gap is a visible `PARTIAL` |
| ABG / point-of-care analysers | **←** | HL7 v2 ORU | — |
| `M-27` tele-ICU | **↔** | Internal | The same flowsheet, read remotely |
| `M-14` lab | **←** | HL7 v2 ORU | Results land on the flowsheet in time order |

### M-12.10 Screen specifications

#### S-12-01 · ICU Unit Dashboard

**One-liner.** The unit ranked by who is deteriorating, not by bed number.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Route** | `/icu/board` |
| **Archetype** | `ARC-12` wall · density compact |
| **Persona** | `P-18` · `P-08` |
| **Permission** | `icu.read` @ `unit`. |
| **Entry** | Default landing for `P-18` · `GP-02` ▸ Critical care · wall display · `NTF-02` |
| **Exit** | Bed → `S-12-02` · ▸ Watch → `S-12-05` · ▸ Requests → `S-12-07` · death → `S-13-06` |
| **In workflows** | `W-12-1` s1 |
| **AI** | ◆AI-201 ◆AI-202 ◆AI-215 |
| **Tier / status** | T1 · ✅ |

**Zones.** `Z1` `Z2` — `GP-01`, `GP-02`, no deviation · `Z3` — n/a: not patient-scoped · `Z5` — the entire viewport — no `Z1`, no `Z2`, no input affordances · `Z7b` — ⊘ absent: `ARC-12` walls carry no input affordances (§6.1)

**Table columns.** Bed · patient · day of stay · ventilation state · `◆AI-201` deterioration · `◆AI-202` sepsis signal · `◆AI-215` severity · alerts unacknowledged

**Actions.**

| Action | Placement | Style | Enabled when | On activate | Confirm |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Open patient | bed click | primary | `relationship` | → `S-12-02` flowsheet | none |
| Acknowledge alert | bed inline | primary | an alert is active | records acknowledgement; ⚠️ alert-fatigue counter feeds `S-25-07` | none |
| Sort by bed | `Z4` | secondary | always | ⚠️ the deterministic order, one click away | none |
| Open daily goals | bed menu | secondary | `P-18` | → `S-12-06` | none |

**AI touchpoints.**

| AI | Capability | Pattern | Gate | Explain | Guardrail |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AI-201` | Deterioration risk (NEWS2+) | `AIP-05`, `AIP-06` | G1 | **Mandatory** | Abstains below the recency floor |
| `AI-202` | Sepsis watch | `AIP-05` | G1 | **Mandatory** | ⚠️ Manual screening tool remains; the 1-hour bundle is a deterministic order set |
| `AI-215` | Mortality & severity scoring (APACHE, SOFA, SAPS) | `AIP-02`, `AIP-06` | G1 | Mandatory | ⚠️ **Never used for a treatment-limitation decision.** Manual entry remains |
| `AI-911` | Contextual assistant | `AIP-04` | G1 | ⚠️ Mandatory, cited | §6.1 — never clinical, grounded or silent |

**States.**

| Code | What to draw |
|---|---|
| `LOADING` | `C-45` skeleton matching the loaded geometry; `Z7a` disabled |
| `EMPTY` | explains why it is empty and the action that would change that |
| `PARTIAL` | the failed region names what is missing and since when; the rest stays usable |
| `ERROR` | recoverable, input preserved, retry plus an escape hatch |
| `VALIDATION` | problem count, inline errors, focus to the first, primary stays disabled |
| `DENIED` | `C-36` panel — what is missing, who grants it, request action. ⚠️ **no patient data on screen** |
| `BREAKGLASS` | `GP-10` amber banner, reason before content renders, "logged and reviewed" |
| `OFFLINE` | `C-37` strip — what works, what is queued, what is blocked; typed content never lost |
| `STALE` | timestamp turns amber, "Data as of HH:MM · Refresh" |
| `SAVING` | primary disabled with a spinner; content not locked |
| `LOCKED` | read-only naming who holds it and since when, plus the legitimate next action |
| `AI-OFF` | every `◆` affordance **hidden, not greyed**; the `Z7b` bubble hidden; one quiet line; screen fully usable |
| `AI-ABSTAIN` | states what is missing and the action that would fix it; **never a null or zero score** |
| `AI-LOW` | delivered collapsed with an amber band; acceptance blocked until expanded |

**Responsive.** ≥1920 wall density, readable at 4m · 1024–1919 desktop density, same content · <768 ⚠️ **phone-first variant** — the case rail only, tap to expand

**Keyboard.** ⊘ none — a wall has no operator at it.

**Accessibility.** Every `◆` region is `role="region"` with the confidence band in its accessible name — never colour alone. · Clinical status carries an icon **and** text (§5.3); abnormal reads `↑ High`, not a red cell. · Contrast ≥4.5:1 in both themes; touch targets ≥44px.

**Sample data.** `ICU-1` at `SD-F-01`, 12 beds — ⚠️ `SD-P-07` septic shock, ventilated, rising lactate and a sepsis signal.

**Drawing notes.** ⚠️ Deck beat #15. Draw the board ranked by deterioration with **the three parameters that moved** shown per patient. That specificity is what makes it credible. · ⚠️ `AI-215` mortality scores are visible but the drawer must state they may **never** inform a treatment-limitation decision. · Wall frame and a desktop frame both matter; this runs unattended for a shift.

## M-13 · Discharge, Summary & Care Transitions

**In one line.** The handover that decides whether the patient comes back.

### M-13.1 Purpose & scope boundary

**Purpose.** The discharge readiness board, discharge summary authoring,
discharge medication reconciliation, billing clearance, follow-up and referral
scheduling, death/MCCD/body handover, and readmission-risk-driven
post-discharge outreach.

**Does NOT cover.** Bed release is `M-08`. Final invoicing is `M-19`; this
module owns the **clearance gate**. TPA discharge approval is `M-20`; this module
shows and waits on it. Home health visits are `M-27`.

**⚠️ The discharge summary is the single most legally and clinically
consequential document the hospital produces**, and `CMP-NABH-04` defines a
minimum content set. `S-13-02`'s `Sign` action is **blocked until that set is
complete, with the gaps named** — which is a different design from a warning.

**What the client will judge this module on.** Discharge time of day. If
`AI-610` predicts discharges at 07:00, `S-20-03` chases TPA approval in parallel,
and `S-13-03` reconciles medication before the consultant arrives, discharges
happen at 11:00 instead of 17:00 — and that is worth roughly 0.4 of a bed-day per
discharge across 1,400 beds.

is going home, so your TPA desk starts chasing approval while the consultant is
still on the round — and the discharge summary is drafted from the admission,
with the medication list reconciled and the codes attached. The patient leaves at
eleven with a summary in her own language."*

#### W-13-1 · Discharge from prediction to departure

**Spine.** `S-13-01 → S-13-02 → S-13-03 → S-20-03 → S-13-04 → S-19-06 → S-13-05`
**Trigger.** 07:00 discharge huddle. Deck beats #23–#25.
**⚠️ The commercial point.** Predicting at 07:00 and chasing TPA in parallel
moves discharge from 17:00 to 11:00 — worth ~0.4 bed-days per discharge.

clinically · `O4` discharge against advice

## M-14 · Laboratory (LIS)

**In one line.** Specimen to validated result, with the critical ones escalated.

### M-14.1 Purpose & scope boundary

**Purpose.** The lab worklist, specimen collection and labelling, receipt and
accession, analyser interfacing and result entry, result validation and release,
microbiology and culture, histopathology and cytology, internal QC, the report
composer, and TAT/rejection analytics.

**Does NOT cover.** Ordering is `M-09`; result *review* by the clinician is
`M-09`. Blood bank is `M-17`. Consumables and reagent stock are `M-21`.
Equipment calibration records are `M-21`; the QC *of the assay* is here.

**⚠️ Release is a gate, not a save.** A result becomes visible to a clinician
only on **validation and release** by an authorised person (`S-14-05`), and a
critical value triggers `M-09`'s closed-loop escalation at the moment of release,
not at the moment of entry.

**What the client will judge this module on.** Turnaround time, and whether
NABL evidence (IQC, EQAS, calibration, competency, method validation) comes out
of the system as a by-product rather than a quarterly scramble.

### M-14.2 Personas & permissions

| Persona | What they do here | Owns screens | Scope | Density | Device |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `P-10` Lab Technician | Collection, accession, entry, QC | `S-14-01`…`S-14-04`, `S-14-08` | `unit` | **Compact** | Bench, gloved |
| `P-11` Pathologist | Validation, release, micro, histo, reports | `S-14-05`…`S-14-07`, `S-14-09` | `unit`, `result.release` | Comfortable | Dual-screen |
| `P-07` Staff Nurse | Ward-side collection | `S-14-02` | `unit` | Compact | Bedside |
| `P-25` Quality Manager | TAT and rejection analytics | `S-14-10` | `facility` | Comfortable | Desktop |

**Module AI narrative.** *"The analyser sends a potassium of 7.1 and the system
knows two things at once: that it is implausible given this patient's last three
results, and that if it is real it is a medical emergency. So it flags a possible
haemolysed sample to the technician and, on release, escalates to a named
clinician who must acknowledge."*

**Drawing notes.** ⚠️ Draw the **quarantine with its count**. A QC breach that does not hold back results is a QC theatre. · The Levey-Jennings chart must be readable manually — that is the `AI-OFF` fallback.

## M-15 · Radiology, Imaging & PACS

**In one line.** Order to image to report, with AI reading first.

### M-15.1 Purpose & scope boundary

**Purpose.** The radiology worklist, modality scheduling, study acquisition and
protocol, the image viewer with AI overlay, report dictation and authoring,
critical-finding escalation, the PCPNDT Form F gate, the radiation dose and AERB
register, and per-site imaging-AI performance.

**Does NOT cover.** Stroke-specific imaging AI — ICH, LVO, ASPECTS, perfusion —
is `M-18`, which consumes the same viewer but with its own clock-driven surface.
Ordering is `M-09`. Equipment maintenance is `M-21`.

**⚠️ `CMP-DIAG-01` is an absolute gate.** No obstetric ultrasound report
releases without a completed Form F. This is not a warning, a reminder or a
soft block — it is a hard, deterministic refusal, and `AI-812` monitors
compliance rather than deciding it.

**What the client will judge this module on.** Report turnaround, and whether
the AI overlay is trustworthy enough that a radiologist leaves it on — which
depends entirely on the unannotated series being one tap away and on `S-15-09`
showing honest per-site performance.

### M-15.2 Personas & permissions

| `P-13` Radiologist | Viewer, report, escalation | `S-15-04`…`S-15-06` | `unit`, `report.sign` | **Compact** | Diagnostic workstation, ⚠️ dark room |
| `P-12` Radiographer | Scheduling, acquisition, protocol, dose | `S-15-01`…`S-15-03`, `S-15-07` | `unit` | Compact | Modality console |

| `AI-811` | Statutory register completeness | `S-15-08` | `AIP-05` | G1 | Mandatory | Manual register review remains |

**⚠️ `S-15-09` is the screen that makes the imaging AI credible.** A model
validated at the hub (`SD-F-01`, modern scanners, tertiary case mix) may
degrade badly at `SD-F-03` on older equipment with a different population.
Per-site performance is reported, and a per-site regression is an **alert**, not
a row in a monthly report. In a hub-and-spoke stroke network this is precisely the
failure that must not go unnoticed.

**Module AI narrative.** *"The AI reads every chest film as it arrives and moves
the three that need attention to the top of your radiologist's list, with the
region highlighted — and the unannotated image is always one tap away, which is
why they leave the overlay on. And you can see, per hospital, whether the model
is still as good as the day you bought it."*

## M-16 · Pharmacy & Medication Management

**In one line.** Prescription to dispensed drug, with the batch traceable.

### M-16.1 Purpose & scope boundary

**Purpose.** The dispensing queue, prescription verification and dispense, batch
and expiry barcode picking, the Schedule H1 / X / NDPS registers, IP drug chart
and ward supply, returns and wastage, antimicrobial stewardship, ADR reporting,
pharmacy stock and reorder, and DPCO price control.

**Does NOT cover.** Prescribing is `M-06`/`M-09`. Administration is `M-10`.
Central store, procurement and vendors are `M-21`; this module owns pharmacy
**dispensing stock** and its batches.

**⚠️ `DD-011` — one stock ledger, not two.** Pharmacy-local stock that diverges
from the central materials ledger is endemic in Indian HIS installations and
produces two different answers to "how many vials do we have". Batch mastery is
single; `M-21` and `M-16` are two views of one ledger, and `S-16-09` states which
view it is showing.

**What the client will judge this module on.** Whether expiry and batch
traceability actually work at the counter — scan-driven, with the batch recorded
against the patient — and whether the H1 and NDPS registers are producible on
demand rather than reconstructed monthly.

### M-16.2 Personas & permissions

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `P-14` Pharmacist | Verification, dispense, registers, stewardship | `S-16-01`, `S-16-02`, `S-16-04`, `S-16-07`…`S-16-10` | `facility`, `rx.dispense` | Compact | Counter |
| `P-15` Pharmacy Technician | Picking, ward supply, returns | `S-16-03`, `S-16-05`, `S-16-06` | `facility` | **Compact** | Handheld, store |
| `P-08` Nurse-in-Charge | Ward supply requests | — | `unit` | Compact | Nursing station |

**Module AI narrative.** *"The pharmacist scans, and the system picks the batch
that expires first while flagging the ₹2.4 lakh of stock that will expire before
you can sell it. Interaction and allergy checks run at the counter as well as at
prescribing — because the counter is the last place to catch it."*

## M-17 · Blood Bank, Dialysis & Allied Health

**In one line.** Transfusion, renal replacement, physiotherapy and nutrition.

### M-17.1 Purpose & scope boundary

**Purpose.** Four therapeutic services that share a pattern — a scheduled or
requested session, a clinical record of that session, and an outcome. Blood bank
inventory, donor registration and deferral, cross-match and issue, transfusion
administration and reaction; dialysis scheduling and the session record;
physiotherapy and rehab plans with functional scales; dietetics assessment and
diet orders.

**Does NOT cover.** Diet *production and delivery* is `M-22`; this module owns
the clinical **diet order**. Nursing administration of blood is charted here but
the eMAR pattern comes from `M-10`. Rehab *scheduling* of home visits is `M-27`.

**⚠️ Why these four share a module.** They are grouped because each is a
low-screen-count therapeutic service with an identical shape, not because they
are clinically related. If the client's volumes justify it, blood bank and
dialysis each split cleanly into their own module without touching any other —
that is what `M-28`…`M-32` are reserved for.

**What the client will judge this module on.** Blood bank statutory compliance
— e-Raktkosh, donor deferral, the mandatory TTI panel — because that is where an
inspection failure closes a service.

| `P-10` Lab Technician (blood bank) | Inventory, donors, cross-match, issue | `S-17-01`…`S-17-03` | `unit` | Compact | Bench, gloved |

OT list, so O-negative does not run out on a Friday. And for stroke and ortho
patients the rehab plan carries a predicted functional outcome alongside the
measured one — which is what makes a 90-day follow-up conversation concrete."*

## M-18 · Stroke-AI Command Centre

**In one line.** A hub-and-spoke stroke network run as a clock, not a queue.

> **This module is designed from zero.** `docs/DOMAIN_MAP.md:190-219` records the
> Stroke Command Centre as **"NOT PRESENT IN SOURCE. Zero owned requirements. No
> modules."** In 28,800 lines of the existing corpus the only matches for
> "stroke" are signature-pad canvas strokes. Nothing here inherits from that
> corpus, and the document says so deliberately — with a clinical client, being
> explicit about what is newly designed is an asset, not an admission.

### M-18.1 Purpose & scope boundary

**Purpose.** The acute stroke pathway across a hub-and-spoke network: the
network command wall, code-stroke activation and clock management, telestroke
consultation and spoke coordination, stroke imaging AI and triage, thrombolysis
and thrombectomy decision support, pre-hospital and mobile stroke unit,
inter-facility transfer with single-act resource reservation, and stroke-unit
care with 90-day outcomes and registry export.

**Does NOT cover.** General ED triage is `M-07` — which **activates** this
module and hands over. The imaging *viewer* and PACS are `M-15`; this module
consumes them with its own clock-driven surface. Bed and cath-lab *inventory* are
`M-01`; their *state* is `M-08` and `M-11`. Rehabilitation delivery is `M-17`.
General teleconsultation is `M-27`.

**⚠️ Why a software product is the right answer here.** Stroke treatment is a
race against tissue death — roughly 1.9 million neurons lost per minute of
untreated large-vessel occlusion. But the bottleneck is almost never clinical
skill. It is **coordination**: who was notified and when, whether the CT bay was
free, who read the scan, whether consent and money were settled, and whether a
spoke 90 minutes away should treat locally and ship or ship immediately. Every
one of those is an information problem. That is why this is the flagship.

**The two interventions and their clocks.** IV thrombolysis (alteplase, or
increasingly tenecteplase 0.25 mg/kg in India — materially cheaper and a single
bolus) within 4.5h of last-known-well. Mechanical thrombectomy for large-vessel
occlusion — to 6h routinely, and 6–24h in perfusion- or clinical-mismatch-selected
patients on DAWN/DEFUSE-3 criteria.

**The time targets this module manages**, each a first-class live object rather
than a retrospective report:

| Interval | Target | What the product actually changes |
|---|---|---|
| EMS pre-notification → team assembled | Before arrival | One-tap activation and parallel paging |
| Door → CT start | ≤ 25 min | ⚠️ CT bay reserved **at activation**, not requested at triage |
| CT complete → AI result → team notified | ≤ 5 min | Imaging AI pushed to phones, not queued for a radiologist |
| CT → interpretation | ≤ 20 min | AI pre-read plus remote radiologist |
| **Door → needle (DTN)** | **≤ 60 min, best ≤ 30** | ⚠️ The headline metric. Every blocker made visible live |
| Door → groin puncture | ≤ 90 min | Cath lab and anaesthesia reserved **at decision**, not after |
| **Door-in → door-out (DIDO)** at a spoke | **≤ 60 min** | The metric hub-and-spoke networks fail most often |
| Groin → recanalisation (TICI 2b/3) | ≤ 60 min | Procedure log with a live clock |
| Last-known-well → treatment | The clinical clock | ⚠️ Reconstructed, disputed and audited — hence `DD-012` |

**What the client will judge this module on.** Median door-to-needle, DIDO at
the spokes, and the 90-day mRS follow-up rate — because those three numbers are
what a WSO/Angels award submission and an Indian Stroke Registry entry are made
of, and they are the numbers a stroke network director is personally measured on.

### M-18.2 Personas & permissions

| Persona | What they do here | Owns screens | Scope | Density | Device |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `P-35` Stroke Neurologist (hub, on-call) | Telestroke, decisions, dosing | `S-18-10`…`S-18-12`, `S-18-17` | `relationship` or ⚠️ break-glass | Compact | ⚠️ **Phone first**, at home, 02:00 |
| `P-37` Stroke Coordinator / Nurse | Clock, tasks, paging, transfer, registry | `S-18-05`…`S-18-09`, `S-18-19`, `S-18-20` | `unit`, `facility` | **Compact** | Wall + workstation + phone |
| `P-38` Spoke-Site Physician | Activation, spoke console, local treatment | `S-18-13` | `relationship`, spoke-scoped | Comfortable | ⚠️ Desktop or phone, poor bandwidth, **alone** |
| `P-36` Neuro-Interventionist | EVT selection, cath lab | `S-18-18` | `relationship` | Compact | Tablet + cath console |
| `P-13` Radiologist | Imaging confirmation, ASPECTS | `S-18-15` | `unit` | Compact | Dark reading room |
| `P-39` Paramedic / EMT | Pre-hospital screen, onboard | — (uses `S-18-04`) | Field-scoped | Comfortable | ⚠️ Phone, moving vehicle, one hand |
| `P-40` Dispatcher | Routing, fleet | — (uses `S-22-05`) | `facility` | Compact | Control room |
| `P-41` Stroke Network Director | Wall, site readiness, registry, benchmarking | `S-18-01`, `S-18-03` | `group` | Comfortable | Desktop + wall |

**⚠️ Break-glass is not an edge case in this module — it is the normal path.**
An unidentified stroke patient at 02:00 and a remote neurologist with no prior
care relationship is the *expected* case. `DD-014` requires that access
**proceeds**, the record is written synchronously, the absence of a record is
itself an alert, and every use is reviewed within 24 hours in `S-02-06`. An
authorization model that can refuse here is the wrong model.

| `AI-708` | Post-discharge outreach (mRS-90 campaign) | `S-18-20` | `AIP-07` | G1 | Mandatory | Scheduled call list remains |

**⚠️ Four constraints that define this module's AI posture.**

**One — the clock is never AI-derived.** Every interval on `S-18-06` is computed
from stamped events, and `DD-012` fixes the authority order among manual, DICOM,
device and badge-scan timestamps. A disputed door time is a disputed
door-to-needle, and DTN is what the network is judged on. AI may *predict a
breach*; it may never *set a time*.

**Two — imaging AI prioritises, it does not diagnose.** `AI-403` and `AI-404`
run at `G3`: a human with the relevant capability attests before anything enters
the record. Their value is the four minutes between reconstruction and the
neurologist's phone buzzing, not the interpretation itself.

**Three — cost is displayed and never blocking.** See `S-18-17` and §M-18.6.

**Four — per-site model performance is mandatory, not optional.** A model
validated on hub scanners may degrade at `SD-F-03`. `S-18-03` and `S-15-09`
report per site, and a regression is an alert. In a hub-and-spoke network this is
the failure that must not go unnoticed.

**Module AI narrative.** *"A patient arrives at your Nashik hospital at two in
the morning. A general physician — not a neurologist — opens a console that asks
him six things. The CT is done, and four minutes later the AI has found a
large-vessel occlusion and put it on your on-call neurologist's phone, in
Bengaluru, before anyone has phoned him. They do the NIHSS together over video.
The eligibility checklist knows he is on a DOAC and asks when the last dose was.
The thrombolytic is given at 41 minutes, the cath lab and the ambulance and the
neuro-ICU bed are reserved in one action, and ninety days later the system is
still chasing the follow-up call that your award submission depends on."*

### M-18.6 India & compliance overlay

| CMP | Obligation | UI consequence | Screens |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CMP-PMJAY-02` | HBP stroke package | Package selector; thrombolytic and EVT entitlement | `S-18-17`, `S-18-18` |
| `CMP-TPA-01` | Pre-auth pack assembled from the record | ⚠️ Assembled **in parallel**, never gating treatment | `S-18-17` |
| `CMP-DRUG-03` | DPCO ceiling on thrombolytics | Drug cost shown from the deterministic rate card | `S-18-17` |
| `CMP-ABDM-01` | ABHA where obtainable | ⚠️ **Never a precondition for treatment** | `S-18-05` |
| `CMP-STAT-01` | MLC where the stroke is trauma-associated | MLC docket handoff to `M-24` | `S-18-05` |
| `CMP-NABH-08` | Informed consent before thrombolysis / EVT | ⚠️ Telephone consent with recorded attestation; **thumb impression + witness** supported | `S-18-17` |
| `CMP-NABH-11` | Author identity and reg. no. on every entry | Stamped; the remote examiner is recorded on the NIHSS | `S-18-12` |
| `CMP-DRUG-06` | Telemedicine Practice Guidelines 2020 | RMP identity and HPR ID on any tele-issued instruction | `S-18-11`, `S-18-13` |
| `CMP-DPDP-05` | Session recording consent | Recording consent captured before a session records | `S-18-11` |
| `CMP-INTL-03` | Registry code bindings | Indian Stroke Registry and WSO/Angels metric packs | `S-18-20` |

**⚠️ The cost-and-coverage design principle, stated once.** `S-18-17` shows drug
cost, PM-JAY package status and TPA status **as displayed information with an
explicit "treat now, authorize in parallel" action and an audited override.** In
India, settling money is the most common *non-clinical* cause of thrombolysis
delay. The product's position on that should be a stated design principle rather
than an accident of screen order — and stating it out loud in the client meeting
is a differentiator in itself.

### M-18.7 Integration touchpoints

| System | Dir | Standard | UI consequence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Modalities & PACS at hub and spokes | **↔** | DICOM | ⚠️ Progressive degradation — the decision never waits on a full-resolution series |
| Imaging AI vendor | **←** | DICOM / vendor API | Findings with model@version; push to phone |
| Video platform | **↔** | Vendor via adapter | `S-18-11`; ⚠️ host and join links are role-split and never interchanged |
| Ambulance GPS / telematics | **←** | Vendor | Map, ETA, in-transit deterioration alerting |
| WhatsApp BSP / SMS (DLT) | **→** | Template registry | ⚠️ Team paging and family contact. **No PHI** (§6) |
| Spoke-site EMR | **↔** | HL7 v2 / FHIR, or ⊘ none | ⚠️ **The spoke console must work standalone** — realistically `SD-F-04` has no EMR at all |
| `M-08`, `M-11`, `M-22` | **←** | Internal | Live bed, cath lab and ambulance state for single-act reservation (§2.6 exception) |
| Indian Stroke Registry / WSO | **→** | File export | `S-18-20` submission status |

| Entity | Shown as | Identifier format | Example (§8) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Stroke case | Case rail card, clock panel | `STROKE/{fy}/{seq}` | `STROKE/26-27/0141` |
| Timed event | Clock row, reconciliation row | `{case}/EVT/{seq}` | ⚠️ append-only |
| Time target | Clock ring | `{case}/{interval}` | `DTN`, `DIDO` |
| NIHSS assessment | Guided 15-item score | `{case}/NIHSS/{ts}` | with examiner + mode |
| mRS | Scale row | `{case}/MRS/{point}` | baseline, 90-day |

| ASPECTS | Region map + score | `{study}/ASPECTS` | AI + human retained |
| Reservation | Single-act bundle | `RES/{case}` | bed + lab + crew + ambulance |
| Transfer | DIDO panel | `TRF/{case}` | spoke → hub, and back |

### M-18.9 Workflows

Eight workflows. `W-18-1` is the deck's spine (§10.2 beats 17–21) and the one to
read first — it is one patient's ninety minutes across two hospitals.

#### W-18-1 · Code stroke at a spoke → thrombolysis → transfer → EVT at the hub

**Spine.** `S-18-13 → S-18-04 → S-18-05 → S-18-14 → S-18-11 → S-18-17 → S-18-19 → S-18-20`
**Branches.** ICH found → `S-18-17` aborted, medical management · no LVO →
thrombolyse and keep local · consent refused → documented, no treatment
**Trigger.** `SD-P-05` arrives at `SD-F-03` (Nashik) at 02:14, left-sided
weakness, last known well 01:20.
**Actors.** `P-38` spoke physician (lead on site, **alone**) · `P-35` hub
neurologist (on a phone, at home) · `P-37` stroke coordinator · `P-13`
radiologist · `P-36` interventionist · `P-34` family (by phone)
**Preconditions.** Spoke site has CT · hub on-call roster current · ⚠️ **no
prior care relationship exists between `P-35` and the patient** — break-glass is
the expected path (`DD-014`)
**Terminal outcomes.** `O1` thrombolysed + transferred + EVT · `O2`
thrombolysed, kept local (no LVO) · `O3` ICH — no lysis, medical management ·
`O4` stroke mimic, de-activated · `O5` outside window, no treatment

| 2 | — | `S-18-04` | S: one-tap activation fires. Pages the hub on-call, reserves the spoke CT bay, opens the task board. ⚠️ **CT is reserved at activation, not requested at triage** | ◆AI-209 G1 | 3 |
| 3 | `P-38` | `S-18-05` | U: completes intake. S: `AI-112` extracts structured values from the referral note; every extracted field is marked and editable | ◆AI-112 `AIP-02` G2 | 4? |

| 4! | `P-35` | `S-18-17` | **!** Outside the thrombolysis window. S: eligibility checklist shows the window item as failed **with its consequence stated**; EVT pathway remains open to 24h if imaging selects | ◆AI-203 G1 | 8 (→ `O5`) |

**Failure modes not shown as rows.** Imaging AI unavailable → `AI-OFF`; the
radiologist reads unprioritised and the clock continues unchanged. Video fails →
the session degrades to audio with synchronised imaging; NIHSS is still recorded
with the mode noted. Spoke loses connectivity mid-case → `S-18-13` queues
locally (`DD-015`) and reconciles on reconnect; ⚠️ **the clock is
server-authoritative, so local times are reconciled, never trusted** (`DD-012`).

### M-18.10 Screen specifications

#### S-18-01 · Stroke Network Command Wall

**One-liner.** The network, live, on a wall and on a phone.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Route** | `/stroke/wall` |
| **Archetype** | `ARC-12` wall · density compact |
| **Persona** | `P-41` · `P-37` · `P-35` |
| **Permission** | `stroke.network.read` @ `group` for `P-41`; @ `facility` for `P-37`. ⚠️ Card faces carry no clinical detail beyond age/sex and the active interval. |
| **Entry** | `GP-02` ▸ Stroke · wall display at shift start · `NTF-03` activation |
| **Exit** | Case → `S-18-02` · ▸ Sites → `S-18-03` · ▸ Telestroke queue → `S-18-10` |
| **In workflows** | ⊘ none — reached by navigation only |
| **AI** | ◆AI-209 ◆AI-616 ◆AI-612 |
| **Tier / status** | T1 · ✅ |

```text
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Z5  STROKE NETWORK            21-Sep-2026 02:48 IST        as of 02:48:12   |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| ACTIVE CASES (2)                          | NETWORK MAP                     |
| +---------------------------------------+ |                                 |
| | STROKE/26-27/0141   INS (spoke)       | |      (AWF) hub                  |
| | 47/M   LKW 01:20                      | |        |  \                    |
| |                                       | |        |   \                   |
| |   DTN  ( 34 )  target 60   ON TRACK   | |     (IHY)  (INS)* <-- active    |
| |   D2CT ( 18 )  target 25   DONE       | |              |                  |
| |   DIDO ( -- )  target 60   PENDING    | |            (IKP) no CT          |
| |                                       | |                                 |
| |   <>404 LVO left M1   HIGH            | |   AMB-INS-03  ETA 9 min ->AWF   |
| |   next: consent  owner Dr P.Menon     | |                                 |
| +---------------------------------------+ +---------------------------------+
| | STROKE/26-27/0140   AWF   mimic       | | RESOURCES                       |
| | de-activated 01:12  reason: seizure   | | CATH-1     free                 |
| +---------------------------------------+ | CT AWF     free                 |
|                                           | Stroke beds 2 of 4              |
| TODAY: 3 activations | DTN median 41 min  | On-call    Dr R.Desai (phone)   |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

**Zones.** `Z1` `Z2` — `GP-01`, `GP-02`, no deviation · `Z3` — n/a: not patient-scoped · `Z5` — the entire viewport — no `Z1`, no `Z2`, no input affordances · `Z7b` — ⊘ absent — `ARC-12` walls carry no input affordances (§6.1)

**Table columns.** Case card: case id · site · age/sex · LKW · per-interval clock rings with target and state · `◆AI-404` finding · next action and its owner

**Actions.**

| Action | Placement | Style | Enabled when | On activate | Confirm |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Expand case | case click | primary | `facility` | → `S-18-02` in place | none |
| Acknowledge breach | case inline | primary | a target is breached | ⚠️ structured reason captured **at the moment of breach** | none |
| Open resource strip | `Z5` | secondary | always | cath lab, CT, stroke beds, on-call — live | none |

**AI touchpoints.**

| AI | Capability | Pattern | Gate | Explain | Guardrail |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AI-209` | ⚠️ Time-critical pathway detection (stroke, STEMI, sepsis, trauma) | `AIP-05` | G1 | **Mandatory** | ⚠️ **The one-tap manual activation button is always present and never gated on the model** |
| `AI-616` | Ambulance ETA & inbound forecast | `AIP-06` | G1 | Mandatory | GPS position remains |
| `AI-612` | Census & occupancy forecast | `AIP-06` | G1 | Mandatory | Current census remains |
| `AI-911` | Contextual assistant | `AIP-04` | G1 | ⚠️ Mandatory, cited | §6.1 — never clinical, grounded or silent |

**States.**

| Code | What to draw |
|---|---|
| `LOADING` | `C-45` skeleton matching the loaded geometry; `Z7a` disabled |
| `EMPTY` | "No active stroke cases" with today's activation count and median DTN — the quiet state is still informative |
| `PARTIAL` | the failed region names what is missing and since when; the rest stays usable |
| `ERROR` | recoverable, input preserved, retry plus an escape hatch |
| `VALIDATION` | problem count, inline errors, focus to the first, primary stays disabled |
| `DENIED` | `C-36` panel — what is missing, who grants it, request action. ⚠️ **no patient data on screen** |
| `BREAKGLASS` | `GP-10` amber banner, reason before content renders, "logged and reviewed" |
| `OFFLINE` | ⚠️ the wall declares the partition and names which sites are unreachable; it never silently drops a case |
| `STALE` | ⚠️ past 2× the 5s refresh the wall **dims and states its last-good time in large type**. A wall showing confidently wrong data is worse than one showing none |
| `SAVING` | primary disabled with a spinner; content not locked |
| `LOCKED` | read-only naming who holds it and since when, plus the legitimate next action |
| `AI-OFF` | `◆AI-404` findings hidden; ⚠️ clocks, targets and resource state are **unaffected** — none of them are AI-derived |

| `AI-LOW` | delivered collapsed with an amber band; acceptance blocked until expanded |

**Keyboard.** `e` stamps the focused event · stamping is one keystroke by design.

**Accessibility.** ⚠️ Tabular figures — a clock whose digits shift width is unreadable at a glance. · Breach announced via `aria-live="polite"`; ⚠️ it must not steal focus from a stamping action. · Night theme mandatory. · Every `◆` region is `role="region"` with the confidence band in its accessible name — never colour alone. · Clinical status carries an icon **and** text (§5.3); abnormal reads `↑ High`, not a red cell. · Contrast ≥4.5:1 in both themes; touch targets ≥44px.

**Sample data.** ⚠️ `SD-P-05` — door 02:14, CT start 02:32, CT done 02:41, needle **02:55 → DTN 41 min**; DIDO pending.

**Drawing notes.** ⚠️ **Deck beat #20.** Draw every interval with target, elapsed, projected breach and **who owns the next action**. The owner column is what turns a dashboard into a coordination tool. · ⚠️ State on the frame that the clock is **server-authoritative and append-only** — a disputed door time is a disputed door-to-needle (`DD-012`). · Show one interval projected to breach, amber, with the blocking step named. · Dark theme; phone frame as well as desktop.

## M-19 · Billing, Payments, Tariffs & GST

**In one line.** Every rupee earned, charged, collected and accounted for.

### M-19.1 Purpose & scope boundary

**Purpose.** The collection counter and billing home, the bill desk and
digital collection,
charge capture and posting review, estimates and package quotations, the advance
and deposit ledger, interim and final invoicing, GST classification and
e-invoicing, the tariff and ward-class rate card, consultant revenue share and
payout, shift close with payment-gateway settlement reconciliation, and
revenue-leakage review.

**Does NOT cover.** Payer-side claims, pre-auth and denials are `M-20`. The
statutory general ledger is external — this module *posts outbound* to it. The
service and charge **master** is `M-03`; this module owns the **price**.
Discharge clearance is `M-13`; this module produces the final invoice once
cleared.

**⚠️ Digital-only collection (§2.1 A10).** Every payment on `S-19-02` is UPI,
QR, card, POS or netbanking. There is no cash tender, no drawer and no
denomination count, and `S-19-10` reconciles the payment gateway's settlement
file rather than counting notes. Payment mode is a configurable list so the
policy is reversible without redesigning the module.

**⚠️ `DD-006` again, from the money side.** Price is a function of **(service,
payer, ward class, facility)** — four dimensions, not one. A ward-class change
mid-stay retro-prices the whole stay, and `CMP-GST-02` may reclassify the room
rent as taxable at the same moment. A rate card modelled as a single price per
service will be wrong for most of this client's admissions.

**What the client will judge this module on.** Revenue leakage. An
implant scanned in theatre that never reaches an invoice, a ward-class upgrade
never re-priced, a procedure performed and never charged — `S-19-11` exists
because these are the largest recoverable sums in an Indian hospital's P&L.

### M-19.2 Personas & permissions

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `P-21` Billing Executive | All counter and billing work | `S-19-01`…`S-19-07`, `S-19-10`, `S-19-11` | `facility`, `bill.write`, `payment.collect` | **Compact** | Desktop + printer + POS + QR, ⚠️ queue behind |
| `P-02` Administrator | Tariff governance, leakage review | `S-19-08` | `facility.admin` | Comfortable | Desktop |

| `P-22` TPA Desk | Reads the bill for pre-auth and claims | — | `facility` | Compact | Desk |

### M-19.5 AI capabilities in this module

| AI | Capability | Surfaces on | Pattern | Gate | Explain | Guardrail |

| `AI-502` | Charge capture gap detection | `S-19-02`, `S-19-03`, `S-19-06`, `S-19-11` | `AIP-05`, `AIP-03` | G2 | **Mandatory** | Suggests a missing charge; a human posts it |
| `AI-504` | ⚠️ Tariff & ward-class rate resolution | `S-19-02`, `S-19-04`, `S-19-08` | `AIP-02` | **G2** | **Mandatory** | ⚠️ **The rate itself is a deterministic lookup across (service, payer, ward class, facility).** AI only explains and flags anomalies |
| `AI-503` | Estimate & package cost prediction | `S-19-04` | `AIP-02` | G1 | Mandatory | Rate-card arithmetic remains |
| `AI-505` | GST classification per line | `S-19-06`, `S-19-07` | `AIP-02` | G2 | **Mandatory** | ⚠️ Room-rent and exemption **rules are deterministic**; AI proposes HSN/SAC |
| `AI-506` | Missed-charge & revenue-leakage detection | `S-19-03`, `S-19-11` | `AIP-07`, `AIP-03` | G2 | **Mandatory** | Ranks a review queue; a human posts every recovered charge |
| `AI-517` | Payment & settlement anomaly detection | `S-19-10` | `AIP-05` | G1 | Mandatory | ⚠️ The gateway settlement file is authoritative, not the prediction |
| `AI-518` | Consultant payout reconciliation | `S-19-09` | `AIP-02` | G2 | Mandatory | Manual share computation remains |

**⚠️ The `AI-515` constraint is a policy statement the client should hear.** A
collection-likelihood score must never influence clinical priority, admission or
discharge. It sets *reminder intensity and payment-plan offers* only, and
`S-19-01` says so on the screen. Without that boundary stated, a
collection-propensity model in a hospital is an instrument for denying care to
poor patients.

**Module AI narrative.** *"At the end of the month the system shows you the
₹18 lakh you earned and never billed — the implant scanned in theatre that never
reached an invoice, the ward upgrade never re-priced, the procedure done and not
charged. It ranks them by recoverable value and your billing team works the
list. The rates themselves are never guessed: price is a deterministic lookup
across service, payer, ward class and hospital."*

### M-19.6 India & compliance overlay

| CMP | Obligation | UI consequence | Screens |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CMP-GST-01` | Taxable vs exempt per line | Per-line classification, not per-invoice | `S-19-07` |
| `CMP-GST-02` | ⚠️ Room rent > ₹5,000/day taxable | Automatic reclassification on ward-class change, **shown** | `S-19-07` |
| `CMP-GST-03` | HSN / SAC per line | From `M-03`; `AI-505` suggests, human confirms | `S-19-07` |
| `CMP-GST-04` | IRN + QR on the invoice | Printed per §5.8; generation failure is a visible state | `S-19-06` |
| `CMP-GST-05` | Public display of rates | Statutory rate display | `S-19-04` |
| `CMP-TPA-04` | IRDAI non-payables marked per line | Non-payable lines visibly flagged | `S-19-06` |
| `CMP-PMJAY-05` | Package-vs-actual variance | `ARC-26` comparison before discharge | `S-19-11` |
| `CMP-STAT-07` | TDS on consultant payouts (194J) | Deduction computed on the payout statement | `S-19-09` |

### M-19.7 Integration touchpoints

| System | Dir | Standard | UI consequence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Payment gateway / UPI / QR / POS | **↔** | Vendor via adapter | ⚠️ Card data goes **browser → gateway**, never through this system. Only a token and `last4` return. **The sole collection path — no cash rail exists** (§2.1 A10) |
| GST e-invoice portal (IRP) | **→** | Government API | IRN + QR; failure is a visible, retryable state |
| Group GL / ERP | **→** | File / API | Outbound posting; this module is not the ledger |
| `M-20` payer | **↔** | Internal | Non-payables, deductions and settlements |
| `M-11` implants, `M-16` pharmacy | **←** | Internal | Scan-time charge posting |
| SMS / WhatsApp | **→** | DLT templates | ⚠️ Amount and due date only, no PHI |

### M-19.8 Key data entities

| Entity | Shown as | Identifier format | Example (§8) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Charge | Bill line | `{enc}/CHG/{seq}` | with service + payer + class |
| Invoice | Invoice document | `INV/{fy}/{seq}` | `INV/26-27/118402` |
| Estimate | Estimate letter | `EST/{fy}/{seq}` | `EST/26-27/04417` |
| Payment | Receipt line | `PAY/{fy}/{seq}` | ⚠️ UPI / QR / card / POS / netbanking — **no cash** |
| Deposit | Ledger row | `DEP/{fy}/{seq}` | — |
| Rate card entry | Master row, effective-dated | `{service}/{payer}/{class}/{fac}` | §8.4 |
| Shift close | Close record | `{counter}/{shift}/{date}` | gateway-settlement-wise |

#### S-19-01 · Billing Home & Collection Counter

**One-liner.** The collection counter at the start of a shift.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Route** | `/billing` |
| **Archetype** | `ARC-20` dashboard · density compact |

| **Entry** | Default landing for `P-21` · `GP-02` ▸ Billing |
| **Exit** | ▸ Bill desk → `S-19-02` · ▸ Estimate → `S-19-04` · ▸ Leakage → `S-19-11` · ▸ Shift close → `S-19-10` |
| **In workflows** | `W-19-1` s1 |
| **AI** | ◆AI-601 ◆AI-515 |
| **Tier / status** | T2 · ✅ |

**Zones.** `Z1` `Z2` — `GP-01`, `GP-02`, no deviation · `Z3` — n/a: not patient-scoped · `Z4` — scope selector, period, refresh state · `Z5` — `C-24` tile grid · `Z7b` — `GP-17` assistant bubble, no deviation (§6.1)

**Actions.**

| Action | Placement | Style | Enabled when | On activate | Confirm |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Open bill | `Z5` tile / search | primary | `bill.write` | → `S-19-02` | none |
| New estimate | `Z5` tile | secondary | `facility` | → `S-19-04` | none |
| Close shift | `Z5` tile | secondary | end of shift | → `S-19-10` | none |

**AI touchpoints.**

| AI | Capability | Pattern | Gate | Explain | Guardrail |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AI-601` | Front-office queue & load forecast | `AIP-06` | G0 | On demand | Display only |
| `AI-515` | Collection likelihood & payment nudge | `AIP-06` | G1 | Mandatory | ⚠️ **Never used to refuse or delay care or discharge.** Sets reminder intensity only |
| `AI-911` | Contextual assistant | `AIP-04` | G1 | ⚠️ Mandatory, cited | §6.1 — never clinical, grounded or silent |

**States.**

| Code | What to draw |
|---|---|
| `LOADING` | `C-45` skeleton matching the loaded geometry; `Z7a` disabled |
| `EMPTY` | explains why it is empty and the action that would change that |
| `PARTIAL` | the failed region names what is missing and since when; the rest stays usable |
| `ERROR` | recoverable, input preserved, retry plus an escape hatch |
| `VALIDATION` | problem count, inline errors, focus to the first, primary stays disabled |
| `DENIED` | `C-36` panel — what is missing, who grants it, request action. ⚠️ **no patient data on screen** |
| `BREAKGLASS` | `GP-10` amber banner, reason before content renders, "logged and reviewed" |
| `OFFLINE` | `C-37` strip — what works, what is queued, what is blocked; typed content never lost |
| `STALE` | timestamp turns amber, "Data as of HH:MM · Refresh" |
| `SAVING` | primary disabled with a spinner; content not locked |
| `LOCKED` | read-only naming who holds it and since when, plus the legitimate next action |
| `AI-OFF` | every `◆` affordance **hidden, not greyed**; the `Z7b` bubble hidden; one quiet line; screen fully usable |
| `AI-ABSTAIN` | states what is missing and the action that would fix it; **never a null or zero score** |
| `AI-LOW` | delivered collapsed with an amber band; acceptance blocked until expanded |

**Responsive.** ≥1440 4 columns · 1024–1439 2 columns · <768 1 column, priority order

**Keyboard.** `Enter` drills into the focused tile · `r` refreshes.

**Accessibility.** Every `◆` region is `role="region"` with the confidence band in its accessible name — never colour alone. · Clinical status carries an icon **and** text (§5.3); abnormal reads `↑ High`, not a red cell. · Contrast ≥4.5:1 in both themes; touch targets ≥44px.

**Sample data.** `SD-F-01` counter — 18 waiting, ₹4.2 lakh collected today, 4 discharges pending clearance.

**Drawing notes.** ⚠️ **Digital modes only** (§2.1 A10) — the tiles show UPI, QR, card and POS. No cash drawer, no float, no denomination anything. · ₹ with lakh grouping throughout.

| `PARTIAL` | the failed region names what is missing and since when; the rest stays usable |

| `VALIDATION` | problem count, inline errors, focus to the first, primary stays disabled |

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Work item | row | primary | `bill.write` | → `S-19-03` with the source event | none |
| Route to claim | row menu | primary | encounter closed and claimed | ⚠️ an enhancement or supplementary claim rather than a silent write-off | none |
| Write off | row menu | destructive-tinted | supervisor capability | ⚠️ reason mandatory; counted in the leakage report | ⚠️ modal |
| Sort by value | `Z4` | secondary | always | deterministic order available | none |

**AI touchpoints.**

| AI | Capability | Pattern | Gate | Explain | Guardrail |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AI-506` | Missed-charge & revenue-leakage detection | `AIP-07`, `AIP-03` | G2 | **Mandatory** | Ranks a review queue; a human posts every recovered charge |
| `AI-502` | Charge capture gap detection | `AIP-05`, `AIP-03` | G2 | **Mandatory** | Suggests a missing charge; a human posts it |
| `AI-911` | Contextual assistant | `AIP-04` | G1 | ⚠️ Mandatory, cited | §6.1 — never clinical, grounded or silent |

**States.**

| Code | What to draw |
|---|---|
| `LOADING` | `C-45` skeleton matching the loaded geometry; `Z7a` disabled |
| `EMPTY` | explains why it is empty and the action that would change that |
| `PARTIAL` | the failed region names what is missing and since when; the rest stays usable |
| `ERROR` | recoverable, input preserved, retry plus an escape hatch |
| `VALIDATION` | problem count, inline errors, focus to the first, primary stays disabled |
| `DENIED` | `C-36` panel — what is missing, who grants it, request action. ⚠️ **no patient data on screen** |
| `BREAKGLASS` | `GP-10` amber banner, reason before content renders, "logged and reviewed" |
| `OFFLINE` | `C-37` strip — what works, what is queued, what is blocked; typed content never lost |
| `STALE` | timestamp turns amber, "Data as of HH:MM · Refresh" |
| `SAVING` | primary disabled with a spinner; content not locked |
| `LOCKED` | read-only naming who holds it and since when, plus the legitimate next action |
| `AI-OFF` | every `◆` affordance **hidden, not greyed**; the `Z7b` bubble hidden; one quiet line; screen fully usable |
| `AI-ABSTAIN` | states what is missing and the action that would fix it; **never a null or zero score** |
| `AI-LOW` | delivered collapsed with an amber band; acceptance blocked until expanded |

**Responsive.** ≥1280 list + detail · 1024–1279 detail becomes a drawer · <768 one item at a time

**Keyboard.** `↑`/`↓` move · `a` approve · `r` reject (opens the reason dialog) · bulk actions require an explicit selection.

**Accessibility.** Every `◆` region is `role="region"` with the confidence band in its accessible name — never colour alone. · Clinical status carries an icon **and** text (§5.3); abnormal reads `↑ High`, not a red cell. · Contrast ≥4.5:1 in both themes; touch targets ≥44px.

**Sample data.** ⚠️ ₹18.4 lakh identified this month — implants scanned and unbilled, ward upgrades not re-priced, procedures uncharged.

**Drawing notes.** ⚠️ **The figure is the screen.** Draw "₹18.4 lakh recoverable, ranked by value" large. That number is why a CFO looks at this weekly. · Show the three leakage classes distinctly, each with its own fix path.

## M-20 · Insurance, TPA, PM-JAY & Claims (NHCX)

**In one line.** Getting paid by everyone who is not the patient.

### M-20.1 Purpose & scope boundary

**Purpose.** Payer and scheme eligibility, PM-JAY beneficiary verification and
HBP package selection, the TPA cashless pre-auth and discharge-approval board,
the pre-auth pack builder, enhancement and query response, NHCX claim
submission, claim status and follow-up, deduction/denial/appeal, non-payable and
proportionate-deduction preview, and payer performance analytics.

**Does NOT cover.** Patient-side billing, collection and invoicing are `M-19`.
Coding is `M-24`; this module *consumes* codes. The clinical record the pre-auth
pack is assembled from belongs to its authoring module.

**⚠️ Roughly 75% of this client's revenue arrives through this module**
(§2.1 A3: 24% PM-JAY, 16% other schemes, 35% TPA cashless). It carries more
India-specific screen content than any other module in the atlas, and nothing in
the existing corpus covers any of it.

**What the client will judge this module on.** `S-20-03`. TPA discharge approval
is **the single biggest cause of discharge delay in Indian hospitals** — a
patient clinically ready at 10:00 who leaves at 17:00 because an approval was
faxed and chased by phone. A board that shows every waiting patient, their
elapsed clock and the blocking step is worth real bed-days.

**⚠️ `S-20-09` exists because of a sequencing problem, not a reporting one.**
`CMP-TPA-05` — proportionate room-rent deduction — means that choosing a private
room can reduce reimbursement on *every other line* of the bill. The preview
must therefore appear **before the patient chooses the room class**, on
`S-08-02`, not on the final invoice where it becomes a dispute. Getting that
sequence right is a design decision worth pointing at in the meeting.

**Module AI narrative.** *"The pre-auth pack assembles itself from the clinical
record while your desk executive is still on the phone, and the board tells her
which four of today's thirty discharges are at risk of waiting — ranked by how
long they have already waited and what is blocking them. And before a patient
chooses a private room, you can show them what it does to their reimbursement."*

| `CMP-PMJAY-04` | Blocking, query, claim (TMS) | Distinct states, each with its own SLA clock | `S-20-04`, `S-20-06` |
| `CMP-PMJAY-05` | Package-vs-actual variance pre-discharge | `ARC-26` comparison | `S-20-09` |
| `CMP-PMJAY-06` | CGHS / ECHS / ESI referral letters | Letter upload + validity; ESIC IP validated | `S-20-01` |
| `CMP-TPA-01` | Pre-auth pack from the clinical record | Builder showing present / missing / auto-assembled | `S-20-04` |
| `CMP-TPA-02` | Enhancement when the estimate is exceeded | Triggered by variance, not by memory | `S-20-05` |
| `CMP-TPA-03` | ⚠️ Final approval gates physical discharge | **A dedicated waiting board** | `S-20-03` |
| `CMP-TPA-04` | Non-payables (List I–IV) per line | Flagged on the bill | `S-20-09` |
| `CMP-TPA-05` | ⚠️ Proportionate deduction | Preview **before** the room class is chosen | `S-20-09` |
| `CMP-TPA-06` | NHCX envelope + status polling | Claim state machine, payer-wise turnaround | `S-20-06`, `S-20-07` |

## M-21 · Materials, Inventory, Procurement & Assets

**In one line.** Stock, batches, expiry, purchase, and equipment that must not
fail.

### M-21.1 Purpose & scope boundary

**Purpose.** Stock on hand and the batch ledger, indent/issue/transfer, goods
receipt and quality check, purchase requisition and order, vendors and rate
contracts, expiry and recall, the asset register, preventive maintenance and
calibration, and breakdown/downtime/spares.

**Does NOT cover.** Pharmacy **dispensing** stock is `M-16` — but it is the
*same ledger*, viewed differently (`DD-011`). Implant traceability at
implantation is `M-11`. Sterilisation cycles are `M-22` (CSSD). Statutory
equipment registration (AERB) is `M-15`.

**⚠️ `DD-011` restated from the materials side.** There is **one** batch ledger.
`M-16` and `M-21` are two views of it, and each screen states which view it is
showing. A pharmacy-local stock figure that diverges from the central ledger is
the single most common data-integrity failure in Indian HIS installations, and it
is prevented structurally rather than reconciled monthly.

**What the client will judge this module on.** Expiry wastage and equipment
uptime — specifically whether a critical asset's preventive maintenance is driven
by usage and failure prediction rather than a calendar that everyone ignores.

### M-21.2 Personas & permissions
